creators.name: Andrew Adamatzky
creators.role: Professor of Unconventional Computing, UWE Bristol; director of the Unconventional Computing Laboratory
creators.bio: Computer scientist who builds computers from slime mould, fungi, proteinoids, kombucha and chemical reactions, and edits the International Journal of Unconventional Computing.
creators.why: He has shown, experiment by experiment, that living and chemical matter can sense, route and compute, which opens a design space for living electronics.
creators.role_zh: 英国西英格兰大学（UWE Bristol）非常规计算教授，非常规计算实验室主任
creators.bio_zh: 计算机科学家，用黏菌、真菌、类蛋白、康普茶菌膜和化学反应搭建计算机，并主编《国际非常规计算期刊》。
creators.why_zh: 他用一个又一个实验证明，活体和化学物质也能感知、寻路和计算，为“活的电子器件”打开了设计空间。

creators.name: Jeff Jones
creators.role: Researcher, Unconventional Computing Laboratory, UWE Bristol
creators.bio: Computer scientist who models Physarum polycephalum as swarms of simple particles that lay and follow trails.
creators.why: His particle model became the basis of many generative 'Physarum' simulations used by artists and designers.
creators.role_zh: 英国西英格兰大学非常规计算实验室研究员
creators.bio_zh: 计算机科学家，把多头绒泡菌建模为大量会留下并追随痕迹的简单粒子。
creators.why_zh: 他的粒子模型后来成为许多艺术家和设计师使用的“黏菌”生成式模拟的基础。

creators.name: Ella Gale
creators.role: Researcher in memristors and unconventional computing; formerly at UWE Bristol
creators.bio: Chemist and computer scientist who studied memristive behaviour in slime mould, proteins and other soft matter.
creators.why: She showed that a living slime mould behaves like a memristor, a circuit element with memory.
creators.role_zh: 忆阻器与非常规计算研究者，曾任职于英国西英格兰大学
creators.bio_zh: 化学家与计算机科学家，研究黏菌、蛋白质等软物质中的忆阻行为。
creators.why_zh: 她证明了活的黏菌表现得像忆阻器，一种带记忆的电路元件。

creators.name: Toshiyuki Nakagaki
creators.role: Professor, Research Institute for Electronic Science, Hokkaido University
creators.bio: Biophysicist who showed that the slime mould Physarum polycephalum finds shortest paths through mazes and builds efficient transport networks; two-time Ig Nobel laureate.
creators.why: His experiments made slime mould the reference organism for 'intelligence without a brain' and for biology-inspired network design.
creators.role_zh: 北海道大学电子科学研究所教授
creators.bio_zh: 生物物理学家，证明了多头绒泡菌能在迷宫中找到最短路径、搭建高效的运输网络；两次获得搞笑诺贝尔奖。
creators.why_zh: 他的实验让黏菌成为“没有大脑的智能”和仿生网络设计的标志性生物。

creators.name: Atsushi Tero
creators.role: Professor, Institute of Mathematics for Industry, Kyushu University
creators.bio: Mathematician who turned slime-mould tube growth into a mathematical model for designing adaptive networks.
creators.why: He translated a living organism's behaviour into an algorithm engineers can reuse.
creators.role_zh: 九州大学产业数学研究所教授
creators.bio_zh: 数学家，把黏菌管道的生长转化为设计自适应网络的数学模型。
creators.why_zh: 他把一种生物的行为翻译成工程师可以复用的算法。

creators.name: Audrey Dussutour
creators.role: CNRS Research Director, Research Centre on Animal Cognition, Toulouse
creators.bio: Biologist who studies learning and decision-making in the slime mould Physarum polycephalum, known in France as 'le blob'.
creators.why: She showed that a single cell without neurons can learn, and brought the blob to schools and the International Space Station.
creators.role_zh: 法国国家科学研究中心（CNRS）研究主任，图卢兹动物认知研究中心
creators.bio_zh: 生物学家，研究多头绒泡菌（法国人称之为“le blob”）的学习与决策。
creators.why_zh: 她证明了没有神经元的单个细胞也能学习，并把黏菌带进了学校和国际空间站。

creators.name: Karen Alim
creators.role: Professor of Theory of Biological Networks, Technical University of Munich
creators.bio: Physicist who studies how flow networks in slime moulds and other organisms store information and make decisions.
creators.why: Her work shows how a body without a brain can write memories into its own shape.
creators.role_zh: 慕尼黑工业大学生物网络理论教授
creators.bio_zh: 物理学家，研究黏菌等生物体内的流动网络如何储存信息、做出决策。
creators.why_zh: 她的研究展示了一个没有大脑的身体如何把记忆写进自己的形态。

creators.name: Soichiro Tsuda
creators.role: Researcher in biological and unconventional computing; built the Physarum-controlled robot at the University of Southampton
creators.bio: Computer scientist who used living slime-mould cells as the controller of a walking robot, working with Klaus-Peter Zauner and Yukio-Pegio Gunji.
creators.why: One of the first robots whose 'brain' was a living single-celled organism.
creators.role_zh: 生物计算与非常规计算研究者，在南安普顿大学搭建了黏菌控制的机器人
creators.bio_zh: 计算机科学家，与 Klaus-Peter Zauner 和郡司幸夫合作，把活的黏菌细胞用作步行机器人的控制器。
creators.why_zh: 最早一批以单细胞活体作为“大脑”的机器人之一。

creators.name: Rob Shepherd
creators.role: Faculty member, Sibley School of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, Cornell University; director of the Organic Robotics Lab
creators.bio: Roboticist working on soft robots, sensory skins and robots powered or controlled by biological systems.
creators.why: His lab connected living fungal mycelium to robots as a sensor and controller.
creators.role_zh: 康奈尔大学机械与航空航天工程学院教员，有机机器人实验室主任
creators.bio_zh: 机器人学家，研究软体机器人、传感皮肤，以及由生物系统驱动或控制的机器人。
creators.why_zh: 他的实验室把活的真菌菌丝体接到机器人上，当作传感器和控制器。

creators.name: Anand Kumar Mishra
creators.role: Research associate, Organic Robotics Lab, Cornell University
creators.bio: Engineer who built electrical interfaces that read mycelium signals and used them to drive soft and wheeled robots.
creators.why: He showed a practical way to put a fungus in a robot's control loop.
creators.role_zh: 康奈尔大学有机机器人实验室研究助理
creators.bio_zh: 工程师，搭建了读取菌丝体电信号的接口，并用这些信号驱动软体机器人和轮式机器人。
creators.why_zh: 他给出了一个把真菌放进机器人控制回路的可行方法。

creators.name: Martin Kaltenbrunner
creators.role: Professor, Soft Matter Physics and LIT Soft Materials Lab, Johannes Kepler University Linz
creators.bio: Physicist building soft, stretchable and biodegradable electronics and robots.
creators.why: He uses fungal mycelium skin as a substrate for electronics that can compost.
creators.role_zh: 林茨约翰·开普勒大学软物质物理系教授
creators.bio_zh: 物理学家，研究柔软、可拉伸、可降解的电子器件和机器人。
creators.why_zh: 他用真菌菌丝体皮作为可堆肥电子器件的基底。

creators.name: Yu Fukasawa
creators.role: Associate Professor, Graduate School of Agricultural Science, Tohoku University
creators.bio: Fungal ecologist who studies how wood-decay fungi and mycorrhizal networks sense, remember and signal.
creators.why: His experiments show that a mycelial network can 'remember' and make decisions about where to grow.
creators.role_zh: 东北大学农学研究科副教授
creators.bio_zh: 真菌生态学家，研究木腐真菌和菌根网络如何感知、记忆和传递信号。
creators.why_zh: 他的实验显示，菌丝网络能“记住”过去，并决定往哪里生长。

creators.name: John LaRocco
creators.role: Research scientist, College of Medicine, The Ohio State University
creators.bio: Engineer who grows shiitake mycelium into memristors and other electronic components.
creators.why: He treats edible mushrooms as a cheap, compostable material for computer memory.
creators.role_zh: 俄亥俄州立大学医学院研究科学家
creators.bio_zh: 工程师，把香菇菌丝体培养成忆阻器等电子元件。
creators.why_zh: 他把可食用的蘑菇当作便宜、可堆肥的计算机存储材料。

creators.name: Sam Kriegman
creators.role: Assistant Professor of Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering and Chemical & Biological Engineering, Northwestern University
creators.bio: Computer scientist who uses evolutionary algorithms to design robot bodies, including the first computer-designed organisms (Xenobots).
creators.why: He made AI a designer of living bodies: the algorithm proposes a shape, cells build it.
creators.role_zh: 美国西北大学计算机科学、机械工程与化学生物工程助理教授
creators.bio_zh: 计算机科学家，用进化算法设计机器人身体，包括第一批由计算机设计的生物体（Xenobots）。
creators.why_zh: 他让 AI 成为活体身体的设计者：算法提出形态，细胞把它造出来。

creators.name: Josh Bongard
creators.role: Professor of Computer Science, University of Vermont; Morphology, Evolution & Cognition Lab
creators.bio: Roboticist working on evolutionary robotics and the co-design of bodies and brains.
creators.why: Co-creator of Xenobots, the first reconfigurable organisms designed in simulation.
creators.role_zh: 佛蒙特大学计算机科学教授，形态、进化与认知实验室负责人
creators.bio_zh: 机器人学家，研究进化机器人学以及身体与大脑的协同设计。
creators.why_zh: Xenobots 的共同创造者，这是第一批在模拟中设计的可重构生物体。

creators.name: Michael Levin
creators.role: Distinguished Professor of Biology, Tufts University; director of the Allen Discovery Center
creators.bio: Developmental biologist studying bioelectric signalling and how cells collectively decide what shape to build.
creators.why: His lab builds Xenobots and Anthrobots and argues that cells are a programmable, problem-solving material.
creators.role_zh: 塔夫茨大学生物学杰出教授，艾伦发现中心主任
creators.bio_zh: 发育生物学家，研究生物电信号，以及细胞如何集体决定要长成什么形态。
creators.why_zh: 他的实验室制造了 Xenobots 和 Anthrobots，并主张细胞是一种可编程、会解决问题的材料。

creators.name: Douglas Blackiston
creators.role: Senior Scientist, Allen Discovery Center at Tufts University and Wyss Institute
creators.bio: Biologist who builds Xenobots by hand and grows them from frog stem cells.
creators.why: He is the hands behind the living robots designed in simulation.
creators.role_zh: 塔夫茨大学艾伦发现中心与哈佛 Wyss 研究所资深科学家
creators.bio_zh: 生物学家，亲手组装 Xenobots，并用青蛙干细胞把它们培养出来。
creators.why_zh: 那些在模拟中设计的活体机器人，是由他亲手做出来的。

creators.name: Gizem Gumuskaya
creators.role: Researcher; developed Anthrobots as a PhD student in Michael Levin's lab at Tufts; trained as an architect at MIT
creators.bio: Architect turned synthetic morphologist who builds multicellular robots from adult human cells.
creators.why: She brings a designer's question into biology: what else can human cells build if we change their context?
creators.role_zh: 研究者；在塔夫茨大学 Michael Levin 实验室读博期间开发了 Anthrobots；本科在麻省理工学院学建筑
creators.bio_zh: 从建筑转向合成形态学的研究者，用成人人体细胞制造多细胞机器人。
creators.why_zh: 她把设计师的问题带进生物学：换一个环境，人体细胞还能造出什么？

creators.name: Shoji Takeuchi
creators.role: Professor, Institute of Industrial Science and Graduate School of Information Science and Technology, University of Tokyo; Biohybrid Systems Lab
creators.bio: Engineer who grows muscle tissue and skin on robot skeletons, from muscle-driven fingers and walkers to a living-skin robot face.
creators.why: His lab treats cultured tissue as a robot material, raising questions of care, touch and uncanny likeness.
creators.role_zh: 东京大学生产技术研究所与信息理工学系研究科教授，生物混合系统实验室负责人
creators.bio_zh: 工程师，在机器人骨架上培养肌肉组织和皮肤，从肌肉驱动的手指、行走机器人到覆盖活皮肤的机器人脸。
creators.why_zh: 他的实验室把培养组织当作机器人材料，也引出照料、触感和“恐怖谷”式相似的问题。

creators.name: Kit Parker
creators.role: Tarr Family Professor of Bioengineering and Applied Physics, Harvard SEAS; Disease Biophysics Group
creators.bio: Bioengineer who builds swimming biohybrid animals (jellyfish, ray, fish) from heart muscle cells to study the heart.
creators.why: His animal-shaped biohybrids use form borrowed from nature to reverse-engineer organs.
creators.role_zh: 哈佛大学工程与应用科学学院生物工程与应用物理教授，疾病生物物理课题组负责人
creators.bio_zh: 生物工程师，用心肌细胞制造会游泳的生物混合动物（水母、鳐鱼、鱼），用来研究心脏。
creators.why_zh: 他借用自然界的形态做出动物形状的生物混合体，反过来理解器官。

creators.name: John Dabiri
creators.role: Centennial Professor of Aeronautics and Mechanical Engineering, Caltech
creators.bio: Fluid dynamicist who studies jellyfish swimming and turns live jellyfish into ocean-sensing biohybrids.
creators.why: He proposes using living animals, fitted with small electronics, as low-energy ocean explorers.
creators.role_zh: 加州理工学院航空与机械工程百年教授
creators.bio_zh: 流体力学家，研究水母的游动，并把活水母改造成探测海洋的生物混合体。
creators.why_zh: 他提出给活动物装上微型电子设备，让它们成为低能耗的海洋探测者。

creators.name: Nicole Xu
creators.role: Assistant Professor of Mechanical Engineering, University of Colorado Boulder
creators.bio: Bioengineer who embeds microelectronics in live jellyfish to control and speed up their swimming.
creators.why: She built the first 'cyborg jellyfish' as a low-power ocean robot.
creators.role_zh: 科罗拉多大学博尔德分校机械工程助理教授
creators.bio_zh: 生物工程师，把微电子装置嵌入活水母体内，控制并加快它们的游动。
creators.why_zh: 她做出了第一只作为低功耗海洋机器人的“赛博水母”。

creators.name: Rashid Bashir
creators.role: Dean of the Grainger College of Engineering and Professor of Bioengineering, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
creators.bio: Bioengineer whose group makes 'bio-bots': 3D-printed hydrogel skeletons that walk using heart or skeletal muscle cells.
creators.why: His bio-bots made muscle-powered machines a reproducible engineering platform.
creators.role_zh: 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校格兰杰工程学院院长、生物工程教授
creators.bio_zh: 生物工程师，团队制作“生物机器人”：3D 打印的水凝胶骨架，用心肌或骨骼肌细胞驱动行走。
creators.why_zh: 他的生物机器人让肌肉驱动的机器成为一个可重复的工程平台。

creators.name: Taher Saif
creators.role: Professor of Mechanical Science and Engineering, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
creators.bio: Mechanical engineer who builds micro-scale swimmers powered by heart cells and by motor neurons driving muscle.
creators.why: His bots show how living tissue can self-organise into a working machine.
creators.role_zh: 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校机械科学与工程教授
creators.bio_zh: 机械工程师，制造由心肌细胞、以及由运动神经元驱动肌肉的微型游泳机器人。
creators.why_zh: 他的机器人展示了活组织如何自组织成一台能工作的机器。

creators.name: Ritu Raman
creators.role: Assistant Professor of Mechanical Engineering, MIT
creators.bio: Engineer who builds adaptive machines from living muscle and nerve tissue, and writes about biofabrication.
creators.why: She treats muscle as a material that can grow stronger with exercise and heal itself.
creators.role_zh: 麻省理工学院机械工程助理教授
creators.bio_zh: 工程师，用活的肌肉和神经组织制造会适应的机器，也撰写关于生物制造的书。
creators.why_zh: 她把肌肉当作一种会越练越强、还能自我修复的材料。

creators.name: Metin Sitti
creators.role: Roboticist; founding director of the Physical Intelligence Department, Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems
creators.bio: Roboticist working on small-scale, soft and bio-inspired robots, including microrobots propelled by bacteria.
creators.why: His microswimmers use living bacteria as motors for medical robots inside the body.
creators.role_zh: 机器人学家，马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所物理智能部门创始主任
creators.bio_zh: 机器人学家，研究微尺度、软体和仿生机器人，包括由细菌推动的微型机器人。
creators.why_zh: 他的微型游泳机器人把活细菌当作体内医疗机器人的马达。

creators.name: Victoria Webster-Wood
creators.role: Associate Professor of Mechanical Engineering, Carnegie Mellon University; Biohybrid and Organic Robotics Group
creators.bio: Engineer who builds biohybrid robots from sea-slug (Aplysia) muscle and nerve tissue and organic materials.
creators.why: She uses tissue from a hardy marine animal to make biohybrid robots that tolerate real-world conditions.
creators.role_zh: 卡内基梅隆大学机械工程副教授，生物混合与有机机器人课题组负责人
creators.bio_zh: 工程师，用海兔（Aplysia）的肌肉、神经组织和有机材料制造生物混合机器人。
creators.why_zh: 她用耐受力强的海洋动物组织，让生物混合机器人能适应真实环境。

creators.name: Hirotaka Sato
creators.role: Provost's Chair Professor, School of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, Nanyang Technological University
creators.bio: Engineer who steers living beetles and cockroaches with small electronic backpacks that stimulate their muscles or antennae.
creators.why: His insect-computer hybrids use the insect's own body and reflexes instead of building a robot from scratch.
creators.role_zh: 新加坡南洋理工大学机械与航空航天工程学院教务长讲席教授
creators.bio_zh: 工程师，用小型电子“背包”刺激甲虫和蟑螂的肌肉或触角，操控这些活昆虫。
creators.why_zh: 他的昆虫-计算机混合体直接利用昆虫自己的身体和反射，而不是从零造一台机器人。

creators.name: Kenjiro Fukuda
creators.role: Senior Research Scientist, Thin-Film Device Laboratory, RIKEN
creators.bio: Engineer developing ultrathin organic solar cells and electronics that can be worn by skin, plants and insects.
creators.why: He gave cyborg insects a solar power source thin enough not to hinder their movement.
creators.role_zh: 日本理化学研究所（RIKEN）薄膜器件实验室资深研究员
creators.bio_zh: 工程师，开发超薄有机太阳能电池和电子器件，可贴在皮肤、植物和昆虫身上。
creators.why_zh: 他给赛博昆虫装上了足够薄、不妨碍行动的太阳能电源。

creators.name: Daniel Preston
creators.role: Assistant Professor of Mechanical Engineering, Rice University; Preston Innovation Laboratory
creators.bio: Engineer working on soft robotics and energy; coined 'necrobotics' for robots made from dead organisms.
creators.why: He repurposes the bodies of dead animals as ready-made actuators, a provocation about what counts as a robot material.
creators.role_zh: 莱斯大学机械工程助理教授，Preston 创新实验室负责人
creators.bio_zh: 工程师，研究软体机器人与能源，提出“死体机器人学”（necrobotics）这一概念。
creators.why_zh: 他把死去动物的身体改作现成的执行器，挑战人们对机器人材料的认知。

creators.name: Sawyer Fuller
creators.role: Faculty member in Mechanical Engineering, University of Washington; leads the Autonomous Insect Robotics Lab
creators.bio: Roboticist building insect-sized flying robots and sensors that borrow from insect biology.
creators.why: His team flew a drone that smells with a live moth antenna.
creators.role_zh: 华盛顿大学机械工程系教员，自主昆虫机器人实验室负责人
creators.bio_zh: 机器人学家，制造昆虫尺寸的飞行机器人，以及借用昆虫生物结构的传感器。
creators.why_zh: 他的团队让一架无人机用活飞蛾的触角来闻气味。

creators.name: Barani Raman
creators.role: Professor of Biomedical Engineering, Washington University in St. Louis
creators.bio: Neuroengineer who studies insect olfaction and reads locust brain signals to detect explosives.
creators.why: He uses a living insect's nose and brain as a chemical sensor.
creators.role_zh: 圣路易斯华盛顿大学生物医学工程教授
creators.bio_zh: 神经工程师，研究昆虫嗅觉，并读取蝗虫大脑信号来探测爆炸物。
creators.why_zh: 他把活昆虫的鼻子和大脑当作化学传感器。

creators.name: Ryohei Kanzaki
creators.role: Professor, Research Center for Advanced Science and Technology, University of Tokyo
creators.bio: Neuroethologist who studies how silkmoths track odour, using robots driven by live moths.
creators.why: His moth-driven robot lets an insect's brain steer a machine directly.
creators.role_zh: 东京大学先端科学技术研究中心教授
creators.bio_zh: 神经行为学家，研究家蚕蛾如何追踪气味，并使用由活蛾驾驶的机器人。
creators.why_zh: 他的“蛾驾车”机器人让昆虫的大脑直接操控机器。

creators.name: Backyard Brains
creators.role: Neuroscience education company founded by Greg Gage and Tim Marzullo
creators.bio: Company making low-cost neuroscience kits for schools, including the RoboRoach.
creators.why: It put a cyborg-insect kit in consumers' hands and sparked public debate about its ethics.
creators.role_zh: 由 Greg Gage 和 Tim Marzullo 创立的神经科学教育公司
creators.bio_zh: 为学校生产低成本神经科学套件的公司，产品包括 RoboRoach。
creators.why_zh: 它把赛博昆虫套件交到普通人手里，也引发了关于其伦理的公开讨论。

creators.name: Heiko Hamann
creators.role: Professor of Computer Science, University of Konstanz; coordinator of flora robotica
creators.bio: Roboticist working on swarm robotics and robot–plant biohybrids.
creators.why: He led a project in which robots and living plants grow architecture together.
creators.role_zh: 康斯坦茨大学计算机科学教授，flora robotica 项目协调人
creators.bio_zh: 机器人学家，研究群体机器人和机器人-植物生物混合体。
creators.why_zh: 他领导了一个让机器人与活植物一起“长”出建筑的项目。

creators.name: Barbara Mazzolai
creators.role: Associate Director for Robotics and director of the Bioinspired Soft Robotics Lab, Istituto Italiano di Tecnologia
creators.bio: Biologist and roboticist who created the Plantoid, the first robot modelled on plant roots.
creators.why: She takes plants, not animals, as the model for robots that grow instead of walk.
creators.role_zh: 意大利技术研究院机器人副院长、仿生软体机器人实验室主任
creators.bio_zh: 生物学家与机器人学家，创造了 Plantoid，第一台以植物根系为原型的机器人。
creators.why_zh: 她以植物而非动物为原型，让机器人靠生长而不是行走来移动。

creators.name: Leonard Adleman
creators.role: Professor of Computer Science, University of Southern California
creators.bio: Computer scientist, co-inventor of RSA encryption and founder of DNA computing.
creators.why: In 1994 he solved a maths problem in a test tube, proving DNA can compute.
creators.role_zh: 南加州大学计算机科学教授
creators.bio_zh: 计算机科学家，RSA 加密算法的共同发明人，DNA 计算的开创者。
creators.why_zh: 1994 年他在试管里解出了一道数学题，证明了 DNA 可以计算。

creators.name: Lulu Qian
creators.role: Professor of Bioengineering, Caltech
creators.bio: Bioengineer who builds neural networks and circuits out of DNA strands that react in a test tube.
creators.why: Her molecular neural networks recognise patterns and now learn from examples without any electronics.
creators.role_zh: 加州理工学院生物工程教授
creators.bio_zh: 生物工程师，用在试管中反应的 DNA 链搭建神经网络和电路。
creators.why_zh: 她的分子神经网络能识别图案，如今还能在没有任何电子器件的情况下从示例中学习。

creators.name: Erik Winfree
creators.role: Professor of Computer Science, Computation and Neural Systems, and Bioengineering, Caltech
creators.bio: Computer scientist who founded algorithmic DNA self-assembly and molecular programming.
creators.why: He showed that DNA tiles and strands can run algorithms as they assemble.
creators.role_zh: 加州理工学院计算机科学、计算与神经系统及生物工程教授
creators.bio_zh: 计算机科学家，开创了算法式 DNA 自组装和分子编程。
creators.why_zh: 他证明了 DNA 瓦片和 DNA 链可以在组装过程中运行算法。

creators.name: Damien Woods
creators.role: Professor of Computer Science, Maynooth University
creators.bio: Computer scientist working on molecular computing and the theory of self-assembly.
creators.why: He built one DNA tile set that can be reprogrammed to run 21 different algorithms.
creators.role_zh: 爱尔兰梅努斯大学计算机科学教授
creators.bio_zh: 计算机科学家，研究分子计算和自组装理论。
creators.why_zh: 他用一套 DNA 瓦片，通过重新编程运行了 21 种不同的算法。

creators.name: Paul Rothemund
creators.role: Research Professor of Bioengineering, Computing and Mathematical Sciences, and Computation and Neural Systems, Caltech
creators.bio: Computer scientist who invented DNA origami: folding a long DNA strand into any 2D shape with short staple strands.
creators.why: DNA origami turned DNA into a programmable building material at the nanoscale.
creators.role_zh: 加州理工学院生物工程、计算与数学科学、计算与神经系统研究教授
creators.bio_zh: 计算机科学家，发明了 DNA 折纸：用短的“订书钉”链把一条长 DNA 折成任意二维形状。
creators.why_zh: DNA 折纸让 DNA 成为纳米尺度上可编程的建造材料。

creators.name: George Church
creators.role: Professor of Genetics, Harvard Medical School; core faculty, Wyss Institute
creators.bio: Geneticist behind genome sequencing and editing methods, DNA data storage and many synthetic-biology companies.
creators.why: He wrote a whole book into DNA in 2012 and pushes DNA as an archive for human culture.
creators.role_zh: 哈佛医学院遗传学教授，Wyss 研究所核心成员
creators.bio_zh: 遗传学家，开发了基因组测序与编辑方法、DNA 数据存储，并参与创办了许多合成生物学公司。
creators.why_zh: 他在 2012 年把一整本书写进了 DNA，并推动 DNA 成为人类文化的档案库。

creators.name: Seth Shipman
creators.role: Associate Investigator, Gladstone Institutes; Associate Professor, UCSF
creators.bio: Bioengineer who turns living cells into recorders that write events into their own DNA.
creators.why: He stored a short film inside the genomes of living bacteria.
creators.role_zh: 格拉德斯通研究所副研究员，加州大学旧金山分校副教授
creators.bio_zh: 生物工程师，把活细胞变成记录器，让它们把发生的事件写进自己的 DNA。
creators.why_zh: 他把一段短片存进了活细菌的基因组里。

creators.name: Nick Goldman
creators.role: Group Leader, EMBL's European Bioinformatics Institute (EMBL-EBI)
creators.bio: Bioinformatician who, with Ewan Birney, designed an error-tolerant scheme for storing files in synthetic DNA.
creators.why: His team stored Shakespeare's sonnets and a speech recording in DNA.
creators.role_zh: 欧洲分子生物学实验室欧洲生物信息研究所（EMBL-EBI）课题组长
creators.bio_zh: 生物信息学家，与 Ewan Birney 一起设计了一种容错的合成 DNA 文件存储方案。
creators.why_zh: 他的团队把莎士比亚十四行诗和一段演讲录音存进了 DNA。

creators.name: Molecular Information Systems Lab (MISL)
creators.role: Joint lab of the University of Washington and Microsoft Research
creators.bio: Lab that builds DNA data storage and molecular computing systems, from random access to fully automated storage.
creators.why: It treats DNA as a computer-architecture problem, with files, retrieval and search.
creators.role_zh: 华盛顿大学与微软研究院联合实验室
creators.bio_zh: 构建 DNA 数据存储和分子计算系统的实验室，从随机读取到全自动存储。
creators.why_zh: 它把 DNA 当作计算机体系结构问题来处理：有文件、有检索、有搜索。

creators.name: Luis Ceze
creators.role: Professor of Computer Science and Engineering, University of Washington; co-director of MISL
creators.bio: Computer architect who co-leads research on storing and computing with DNA.
creators.why: He brought computer-systems thinking to DNA storage.
creators.role_zh: 华盛顿大学计算机科学与工程教授，MISL 共同负责人
creators.bio_zh: 计算机体系结构学者，共同领导 DNA 存储与计算研究。
creators.why_zh: 他把计算机系统的思路带进了 DNA 存储。

creators.name: Karin Strauss
creators.role: Senior Principal Research Manager, Microsoft Research; affiliate professor, University of Washington
creators.bio: Computer architect who leads Microsoft's DNA data storage research.
creators.why: She pushes DNA toward a practical archival medium for data centres.
creators.role_zh: 微软研究院高级首席研究经理，华盛顿大学兼职教授
creators.bio_zh: 计算机体系结构学者，领导微软的 DNA 数据存储研究。
creators.why_zh: 她推动 DNA 成为数据中心可用的归档介质。

creators.name: Yaniv Erlich
creators.role: Computer scientist and geneticist; formerly Columbia University and the New York Genome Center
creators.bio: Researcher who designed DNA Fountain, a near-optimal coding scheme for DNA storage, and co-created the DNA-of-Things architecture.
creators.why: He showed that objects can carry their own digital blueprint in DNA.
creators.role_zh: 计算机科学家与遗传学家，曾任职于哥伦比亚大学和纽约基因组中心
creators.bio_zh: 研究者，设计了接近理论极限的 DNA 存储编码方案 DNA Fountain，并共同提出“物之 DNA”架构。
creators.why_zh: 他证明了物体可以在 DNA 里携带自己的数字蓝图。

creators.name: Robert Grass
creators.role: Professor, Institute for Chemical and Bioengineering, ETH Zurich
creators.bio: Chemical engineer who encapsulates DNA in glass nanoparticles so data can survive for centuries and travel inside materials.
creators.why: He put DNA memory into everyday materials such as a 3D-printed bunny and plexiglass.
creators.role_zh: 苏黎世联邦理工学院化学与生物工程研究所教授
creators.bio_zh: 化学工程师，把 DNA 封装在玻璃纳米颗粒里，让数据能保存数百年，并能混入材料中。
creators.why_zh: 他把 DNA 记忆放进了 3D 打印的兔子、有机玻璃这样的日常材料里。

creators.name: Catalog
creators.role: DNA data storage and computing start-up (key assets acquired by Biomemory in 2026)
creators.bio: Company that built a machine to write data into DNA from pre-made pieces, and stored English Wikipedia in DNA in 2019.
creators.why: It tried to turn DNA storage and search into an industrial product.
creators.role_zh: DNA 数据存储与计算初创公司（核心资产于 2026 年被 Biomemory 收购）
creators.bio_zh: 公司开发了用预制 DNA 片段写入数据的机器，并在 2019 年把英文维基百科存进了 DNA。
creators.why_zh: 它尝试把 DNA 存储和检索做成工业产品。

creators.name: Biomemory
creators.role: DNA data storage company, spin-out of CNRS and Sorbonne Université
creators.bio: Company that stores data in DNA made by engineered cells and is building DNA storage for data centres.
creators.why: It aims to make DNA a rack-mounted storage medium for the cloud.
creators.role_zh: DNA 数据存储公司，法国国家科学研究中心与索邦大学的衍生企业
creators.bio_zh: 用工程细胞制造的 DNA 存储数据，并为数据中心开发 DNA 存储的公司。
creators.why_zh: 它想让 DNA 成为云端机架上的存储介质。

creators.name: Michael Elowitz
creators.role: Professor of Biology and Bioengineering, Caltech; HHMI Investigator
creators.bio: Biologist who built the repressilator, one of the first synthetic gene circuits, and studies how cells compute.
creators.why: The repressilator showed that a genetic clock can be designed from parts.
creators.role_zh: 加州理工学院生物学与生物工程教授，霍华德·休斯医学研究所研究员
creators.bio_zh: 生物学家，构建了最早的合成基因电路之一“抑制振荡子”，并研究细胞如何计算。
creators.why_zh: 抑制振荡子证明了可以用零件设计出一个基因时钟。

creators.name: James J. Collins
creators.role: Termeer Professor of Medical Engineering and Science, MIT
creators.bio: Bioengineer, a founder of synthetic biology, who built the genetic toggle switch and later paper-based cell-free diagnostics.
creators.why: The toggle switch gave cells a designable one-bit memory.
creators.role_zh: 麻省理工学院医学工程与科学 Termeer 讲席教授
creators.bio_zh: 生物工程师，合成生物学的奠基人之一，构建了基因拨动开关，后来又开发纸基无细胞诊断。
creators.why_zh: 基因拨动开关给了细胞一个可设计的一比特存储器。

creators.name: Yannick Rondelez
creators.role: CNRS Research Director, Gulliver laboratory, ESPCI Paris
creators.bio: Chemist who builds dynamic molecular programs from DNA and enzymes that oscillate, compute and decide.
creators.why: His enzymatic neural networks classify inputs non-linearly in a test tube.
creators.role_zh: 法国国家科学研究中心研究主任，巴黎高等物理化工学院 Gulliver 实验室
creators.bio_zh: 化学家，用 DNA 和酶构建会振荡、计算和决策的动态分子程序。
creators.why_zh: 他的酶促神经网络能在试管中对输入做非线性分类。

creators.name: Milan Stojanovic
creators.role: Professor of Medicine and Biomedical Engineering, Columbia University
creators.bio: Chemist who built MAYA, DNA-enzyme automata that play tic-tac-toe against people.
creators.why: He made molecular computing playable: a game against a well plate of DNA.
creators.role_zh: 哥伦比亚大学医学与生物医学工程教授
creators.bio_zh: 化学家，制造了能和人下井字棋的 DNA 酶自动机 MAYA。
creators.why_zh: 他让分子计算变得可以“玩”：和一板 DNA 下棋。

creators.name: Albert Keung
creators.role: Associate Professor of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering, North Carolina State University
creators.bio: Bioengineer working on DNA data storage and computing, and on synthetic epigenetics.
creators.why: His team built a DNA device that stores, erases and computes in one place.
creators.role_zh: 北卡罗来纳州立大学化学与生物分子工程副教授
creators.bio_zh: 生物工程师，研究 DNA 数据存储与计算，以及合成表观遗传学。
creators.why_zh: 他的团队做出了在同一处完成存储、擦除和计算的 DNA 装置。

creators.name: Ioannis Ieropoulos
creators.role: Microbial fuel cell researcher; founder of the Bristol BioEnergy Centre at the Bristol Robotics Laboratory
creators.bio: Engineer who builds robots and toilets powered by microbial fuel cells, from the EcoBot series to Pee Power.
creators.why: He showed that robots can feed themselves through the metabolism of living microbes.
creators.role_zh: 微生物燃料电池研究者，布里斯托机器人实验室布里斯托生物能源中心创始人
creators.bio_zh: 工程师，制造由微生物燃料电池供能的机器人和厕所，从 EcoBot 系列到 Pee Power。
creators.why_zh: 他证明了机器人可以通过活微生物的新陈代谢来养活自己。

works.title: Physarum Machines: Computers from Slime Mould
works.description: A book that collects experiments in which the slime mould Physarum polycephalum computes: it builds spanning trees and Voronoi diagrams, routes around obstacles, and acts as logic gates and robot controllers.
works.description_zh: 这本书汇集了让多头绒泡菌做计算的实验：它能生成生成树和 Voronoi 图、绕开障碍寻路，还能充当逻辑门和机器人控制器。
works.idea_en: A single cell spreading over oat flakes can be read as a general-purpose, if slow, computer.
works.idea_zh: 一个在燕麦片之间蔓延的单细胞，可以被看作一台缓慢但通用的计算机。
works.method: Data are encoded as positions of nutrients and repellents; the plasmodium's growing and retracting protoplasmic tubes form the output pattern.
works.method_zh: 把数据编码为食物和驱避物的位置，黏菌原质团不断生长和收缩的原生质管构成输出图案。

paper.venue: World Scientific Series on Nonlinear Science

works.title: Language of fungi derived from their electrical spiking activity
works.description: Electrodes pushed into mycelium-colonised substrates of four fungal species recorded trains of electrical spikes; grouping the spikes into 'words' gave vocabularies of up to about 50 words per species.
works.description_zh: 研究者把电极插入四种真菌菌丝体长满的基质中，记录到成串的电脉冲；把脉冲按间隔分成“词”，每个物种的“词汇量”最多约 50 个。
works.idea_en: Treat fungal electrical activity as a signal to decode, maybe even a language, not as noise.
works.idea_zh: 把真菌的电活动当作要解码的信号，甚至一种语言，而不是噪声。
works.method: Sub-dermal needle electrodes and a data logger recorded voltage spikes from enoki, split gill, ghost and caterpillar fungi over days, then spike trains were clustered and analysed with linguistic complexity measures.
works.method_zh: 用皮下针电极和数据记录仪连续数天记录金针菇、裂褶菌、鬼伞菌和虫草的电压脉冲，再对脉冲序列做聚类并用语言复杂度指标分析。

works.title: Towards fungal computer
works.description: A proposal for a computer made of a living mycelium network, in which electrical spikes travelling through hyphae are the signals and the network geometry is the circuit.
works.description_zh: 一篇构想用活菌丝网络做计算机的论文：沿菌丝传播的电脉冲是信号，网络的几何结构就是电路。
works.idea_en: A mushroom colony is a wet, self-growing circuit board.
works.idea_zh: 一片蘑菇菌落，就是一块湿的、会自己长的电路板。
works.method: Based on recorded action-potential-like spikes in oyster mushroom mycelium, the paper outlines how stimuli at some points could be read as spike patterns at others to implement logic.
works.method_zh: 基于在平菇菌丝体中记录到的类动作电位脉冲，论文设想在某些位置施加刺激、在另一些位置读取脉冲图案，以实现逻辑运算。

works.title: Towards fungal sensing skin
works.description: A thin sheet of living Ganoderma mycelium responds to touch and light with changes in its electrical potential, working as a soft sensing skin that could cover robots or buildings.
works.description_zh: 一层薄薄的活灵芝菌丝体在受到触碰和光照时会改变电位，可以当作柔软的传感皮肤，覆盖在机器人或建筑表面。
works.idea_en: A skin that grows, heals and senses because it is alive.
works.idea_zh: 一层因为活着，所以会生长、会愈合、会感知的皮肤。
works.method: Electrodes on a mycelium-bound hemp sheet record spikes and potential shifts when weights press on it or it is illuminated.
works.method_zh: 在菌丝黏结的麻纤维片上安装电极，记录它受压或受光照时的脉冲和电位变化。

works.title: Reactive fungal wearable
works.description: Patches of living oyster mushroom mycelium worn on the body spike electrically when pressed or stretched, turning the fungus into a wearable sensor.
works.description_zh: 戴在身上的活平菇菌丝体贴片在被按压或拉伸时会产生电脉冲，让真菌成为可穿戴传感器。
works.idea_en: Clothing that feels, because a fungus is woven into it.
works.idea_zh: 因为织进了真菌，衣服也有了感觉。
works.method: Mycelium-colonised hemp patches with needle electrodes were stimulated mechanically and their spiking responses recorded.
works.method_zh: 在被菌丝长满的麻纤维贴片中插入针电极，施加机械刺激并记录它的脉冲响应。

works.title: Towards proteinoid computers
works.description: A hypothesis paper proposing that proteinoids, thermal proteins that self-assemble into microspheres and produce electrical spikes, could be wired into networks that compute.
works.description_zh: 一篇假说论文，提出类蛋白（受热生成、能自组装成微球并产生电脉冲的蛋白）可以连成网络来计算。
works.idea_en: Proto-life chemistry, older than cells, may already be able to compute.
works.idea_zh: 比细胞更古老的原始生命化学，也许已经能计算。
works.method: Heating amino acids produces proteinoid microspheres whose spontaneous electrical oscillations are proposed as signals in neuromorphic circuits.
works.method_zh: 加热氨基酸得到类蛋白微球，它们自发的电振荡被设想为类脑电路中的信号。

works.title: Kombucha electronics: electronic circuits on kombucha mats
works.description: Circuits were printed and mounted on dried and living kombucha mats, the cellulose films grown by bacteria and yeast; LEDs and simple circuits kept working even after the mats were folded or crumpled.
works.description_zh: 研究者在干燥和活的康普茶菌膜（由细菌和酵母长成的纤维素膜）上打印和安装电路；菌膜被折叠、揉皱后，LED 和简单电路仍能工作。
works.idea_en: Grow your circuit board from tea, sugar and microbes.
works.idea_zh: 用茶、糖和微生物“长”出你的电路板。
works.method: Conductive polymer tracks were printed and components attached to bacterial cellulose mats from a SCOBY culture, then tested under bending and tearing.
works.method_zh: 在由 SCOBY 菌群长成的细菌纤维素膜上打印导电聚合物线路并安装元件，再测试弯折和撕裂下的表现。

works.title: Road planning with slime mould: if Physarum built motorways
works.description: Oat flakes placed on a map of the UK at the positions of major cities were connected by the slime mould, whose tube network was compared with the real motorway system; later studies repeated this for many countries.
works.description_zh: 研究者把燕麦片放在英国地图上主要城市的位置，让黏菌把它们连起来，再把黏菌的管网与真实的高速公路网对比；后续研究在许多国家重复了这一实验。
works.idea_en: Let an organism draft infrastructure, then compare its plan with ours.
works.idea_zh: 让一种生物先画出基础设施草图，再拿它的方案与人类的对比。
works.method: Physarum plasmodium is inoculated at London on an agar map with oat flakes at urban areas; the resulting protoplasmic network is compared with motorway graphs.
works.method_zh: 在琼脂地图上把黏菌接种在伦敦，在城市位置放燕麦片，再把长出的原生质网络与高速公路图进行比较。

paper.venue: International Journal of Bifurcation and Chaos

works.title: Slime Mould Memristors
works.description: Measurements show that living Physarum polycephalum has a pinched current–voltage loop, the signature of a memristor, so its resistance depends on the current that has passed through it.
works.description_zh: 测量表明，活的多头绒泡菌呈现“捏合”的电流-电压回线，这是忆阻器的特征：它的电阻取决于此前流过的电流。
works.idea_en: A living cell can be a circuit element with memory.
works.idea_zh: 一个活细胞可以是带记忆的电路元件。
works.method: Current–voltage sweeps were applied across slime-mould tubes between electrodes and the hysteresis loops analysed.
works.method_zh: 在电极之间的黏菌管上做电流-电压扫描，分析其迟滞回线。

works.title: FUNGAR — Fungal Architectures
works.description: An EU research project (2019–2023) that aimed to grow a building from living mycelium composites that would sense light, touch and pollutants and process that information, a 'fungal architecture' that computes.
works.description_zh: 欧盟研究项目（2019–2023），目标是用活菌丝体复合材料长出一座建筑，它能感知光、触摸和污染物并处理这些信息，是一种会计算的“真菌建筑”。
works.idea_en: A building whose walls are a living, thinking fungal network.
works.idea_zh: 一座墙体就是活的、会“思考”的真菌网络的建筑。
works.method: Mycelium-bound building blocks with embedded electrodes were tested as sensors and computing elements, alongside functionalisation with nanoparticles.
works.method_zh: 在菌丝体建筑砌块中嵌入电极，测试它们作为传感器和计算单元的能力，并尝试用纳米颗粒对其功能化。

works.title: Maze-solving by an amoeboid organism
works.description: A slime mould filling a maze, given food at the entrance and exit, withdrew from dead ends and kept a single tube along the shortest route.
works.description_zh: 黏菌先铺满整个迷宫；在入口和出口放上食物后，它从死胡同里撤回，只保留一条沿最短路径的管道。
works.idea_en: Intelligence can be a property of growth and shrinkage, not of a brain.
works.idea_zh: 智能可以来自生长与收缩，而不一定来自大脑。
works.method: Pieces of Physarum polycephalum plasmodium were placed in an agar maze; oat flakes at two exits caused tubes on longer paths to disappear.
works.method_zh: 把多头绒泡菌的原质团碎片放入琼脂迷宫，在两个出口放燕麦片，较长路径上的管道随之消失。

works.title: Rules for biologically inspired adaptive network design (slime mould Tokyo rail)
works.description: Oat flakes placed like the cities around Tokyo were linked by the slime mould into a network with efficiency, cost and fault tolerance similar to the real rail system; the authors derived a mathematical model from it.
works.description_zh: 研究者按东京周边城市的位置摆放燕麦片，黏菌把它们连成的网络在效率、成本和容错性上都与真实铁路网相近；作者据此推导出一个数学模型。
works.idea_en: Evolution has already solved network design problems that engineers still work on.
works.idea_zh: 工程师仍在研究的网络设计问题，进化早已给出了答案。
works.method: Physarum was grown on a template of the Kanto region with light used to mimic mountains and sea; tube thickening by flow was captured in a simple adaptive-network model.
works.method_zh: 让黏菌在关东地区的模板上生长，用光照模拟山地和海洋；再把“流量越大管道越粗”的规律写成一个简单的自适应网络模型。

works.title: Amoebae anticipate periodic events
works.description: After being exposed to cold, dry pulses at regular intervals, a slime mould slowed down at the time the next pulse would have come, even when it did not come.
works.description_zh: 黏菌在按固定间隔经历几次低温干燥刺激后，会在“下一次刺激本该到来”的时刻自行放慢速度，即使刺激并没有出现。
works.idea_en: Even a single cell can keep time and expect the future.
works.idea_zh: 即使是一个单细胞，也能记住节奏、预期未来。
works.method: Migrating Physarum was subjected to periodic drops in temperature and humidity; its locomotion speed was tracked and modelled with coupled oscillators.
works.method_zh: 让迁移中的黏菌周期性地经历温度和湿度下降，记录它的移动速度，并用耦合振子模型解释。

works.title: Habituation in non-neural organisms: evidence from slime moulds
works.description: Slime moulds that had to cross a bridge coated with bitter but harmless quinine or caffeine to reach food hesitated less each day, and recovered their aversion after a pause: a simple form of learning without neurons.
works.description_zh: 黏菌要穿过一座涂有苦味但无害的奎宁或咖啡因的“桥”才能吃到食物，它们一天比一天犹豫得少；停止几天后又恢复了厌恶。这是一种没有神经元的简单学习。
works.idea_en: Learning does not need a nervous system.
works.idea_zh: 学习不一定需要神经系统。
works.method: Physarum polycephalum was trained over six days on agar bridges containing repellents; crossing time was compared with naive controls.
works.method_zh: 连续六天让多头绒泡菌穿过含驱避物的琼脂桥，并将穿越时间与未训练的对照组比较。

paper.venue: Proceedings of the Royal Society B

works.title: Élève ton blob (Raise your blob)
works.description: A citizen-science experiment by CNES and CNRS: slime moulds flew to the International Space Station with astronaut Thomas Pesquet while thousands of French classrooms ran the same feeding experiments on Earth.
works.description_zh: 法国国家空间研究中心（CNES）与 CNRS 发起的公众科学实验：黏菌随宇航员 Thomas Pesquet 飞上国际空间站，同时法国数千个班级在地面上做同样的喂养实验。
works.idea_en: A brainless organism can become a shared experiment between astronauts and schoolchildren.
works.idea_zh: 一种没有大脑的生物，可以成为宇航员和中小学生共同参与的实验。
works.method: Dormant, dried Physarum samples were revived in microgravity and in schools; students photographed growth under different food conditions and compared it with the ISS results.
works.method_zh: 把休眠的干燥黏菌样本分别在微重力环境和学校里唤醒；学生在不同喂养条件下拍摄黏菌的生长，并与空间站的结果比较。

works.title: Characteristics of pattern formation and evolution in approximations of Physarum transport networks
works.description: A simulation in which thousands of simple agents deposit and follow a chemical trail reproduces the network patterns of slime mould; the model later spread widely as a generative-art technique.
works.description_zh: 一个模拟：成千上万个简单智能体沉积并追随化学痕迹，再现了黏菌的网络图案；这一模型后来成为广泛使用的生成艺术技法。
works.idea_en: A few local rules for sensing and moving are enough to grow organic networks.
works.idea_zh: 几条关于感知和移动的局部规则，就足以长出有机的网络。
works.method: Particles with forward-facing sensors turn toward higher trail concentration and deposit trail as they move; the trail map diffuses and decays each step.
works.method_zh: 每个粒子有朝前的传感器，转向痕迹浓度更高的方向并在移动时留下痕迹；痕迹图每一步都会扩散和衰减。

works.title: Encoding memory in tube diameter hierarchy of living flow network
works.description: When a slime mould finds food, the tubes near it thicken and others shrink; the pattern of tube widths persists and stores where food was found, working as a memory written into the body.
works.description_zh: 黏菌找到食物后，附近的管道变粗、其他管道变细；这种管径分布会保留下来，记录食物曾经在哪里，就像写在身体里的记忆。
works.idea_en: Memory can be stored in the shape of a body.
works.idea_zh: 记忆可以储存在身体的形状里。
works.method: Microscopy of Physarum networks after local food stimuli, combined with a flow model where a softening agent is carried by cytoplasmic flow.
works.method_zh: 在局部给予食物刺激后用显微镜观察黏菌网络，并结合一个“软化物质随细胞质流动而运输”的流体模型。

works.title: Robot control with biological cells
works.description: A six-legged robot was controlled by a living slime mould grown on a star-shaped circuit; light shone on the cell by the robot's sensors changed its oscillations, which drove the legs. In 2010 Tsuda also drove a wheeled robot the same way.
works.description_zh: 一台六足机器人由生长在星形电路上的活黏菌控制：机器人传感器把光照投到黏菌上，改变它的振荡节律，节律再驱动机器人的腿。2010 年，Tsuda 又用同样的方法驱动了一台轮式机器人。
works.idea_en: Use the rhythm of a living cell as a robot's nervous system.
works.idea_zh: 用活细胞的节律充当机器人的神经系统。
works.method: Physarum on a patterned electrode reacts to light stimuli; its local thickness oscillations are measured and mapped to motor commands for a hexapod robot.
works.method_zh: 生长在图案电极上的黏菌对光刺激产生反应，测量其局部厚度振荡并映射为六足机器人的电机指令。

works.title: Biocomputer Music
works.description: A piano duet between composer Eduardo Miranda and a biocomputer: notes he plays are sent through slime-mould memristors, and the altered currents come back as the biocomputer's reply played on the same piano.
works.description_zh: 作曲家 Eduardo Miranda 与一台生物计算机的钢琴二重奏：他弹奏的音符被转成电信号送入黏菌忆阻器，经黏菌改变后的电流再作为“回应”在同一架钢琴上弹奏出来。
works.idea_en: Improvise with a living organism as a musical partner.
works.idea_zh: 把一种活的生物当作即兴演奏的音乐伙伴。
works.method: Physarum polycephalum grown between electrodes acts as a memristor; MIDI notes are converted to voltages, and the resulting current is mapped back to notes played by electromagnets on the piano.
works.method_zh: 生长在电极之间的多头绒泡菌充当忆阻器；MIDI 音符被转成电压，产生的电流再被映射回音符，由电磁铁在钢琴上弹奏。

works.title: Sensorimotor control of robots mediated by electrophysiological measurements of fungal mycelia
works.description: Two robots, a soft star-shaped walker and a wheeled rover, were driven by electrical spikes from living king oyster mycelium; shining UV light on the fungus changed its signals and so the robots' gait.
works.description_zh: 一台柔软的星形步行机器人和一台轮式小车，由活的杏鲍菇菌丝体的电脉冲驱动；用紫外光照射真菌会改变它的信号，从而改变机器人的步态。
works.idea_en: Put a fungus in the control loop so the robot senses the world through a living organism.
works.idea_zh: 把真菌放进控制回路，让机器人通过一个活的生物来感知世界。
works.method: Mycelium grown into an electrode interface in a 3D-printed scaffold; its spikes are filtered and converted into actuator commands, with UV light as the stimulus.
works.method_zh: 让菌丝体长进 3D 打印支架中的电极接口，对其电脉冲滤波后转换为执行器指令，并以紫外光作为刺激。

works.title: MycelioTronics: Fungal mycelium skin for sustainable electronics
works.description: The thin skin that Ganoderma lucidum grows on wood is peeled off and used as a flexible, heat-resistant substrate for circuit boards, batteries and sensors that decompose in soil.
works.description_zh: 把灵芝在木材上长出的薄皮剥下来，用作电路板、电池和传感器的柔性耐热基底，这些器件可以在土壤中降解。
works.idea_en: Replace plastic circuit boards with a skin grown by a fungus.
works.idea_zh: 用真菌长出的皮替代塑料电路板。
works.method: Mycelium skins are harvested from beech-wood cultures, dried and laminated, then metallised with laser-patterned copper and gold tracks.
works.method_zh: 从山毛榉木屑培养物上采下菌丝体皮，干燥压平后，用激光图案化的铜和金线路进行金属化。

works.title: Ecological memory and relocation decisions in fungal mycelial networks
works.description: A wood-decay fungus that grew from one wood block to a new one 'remembered' the direction it had come from: when moved to fresh soil, it regrew mainly from the side facing its former target.
works.description_zh: 一种木腐真菌从一块木块长向另一块新木块；把原木块移到新土壤后，它主要从朝向之前目标的一侧重新长出，好像“记得”方向。
works.idea_en: A mycelial network carries a memory of where it has been going.
works.idea_zh: 菌丝网络记得自己一直在往哪里去。
works.method: Phanerochaete velutina was grown between wood blocks on soil; after transferring the original block, the direction and extent of new growth were measured.
works.method_zh: 让绒毛平革菌在土壤上从一块木块长向另一块，再把原木块转移，测量新菌丝生长的方向和范围。

works.title: Sustainable memristors from shiitake mycelium for high-frequency bioelectronics
works.description: Dehydrated shiitake mycelium was wired into circuits and worked as a memristor, switching at up to about 5,850 times per second with around 90% accuracy.
works.description_zh: 研究者把脱水的香菇菌丝体接入电路，它可以作为忆阻器工作，切换频率最高约每秒 5850 次，准确率约 90%。
works.idea_en: Grow computer memory from edible mushrooms instead of mining rare materials.
works.idea_zh: 用可食用的蘑菇长出计算机存储器，而不是开采稀有材料。
works.method: Shiitake mycelium cultured on growth medium was dried, rehydrated and connected with electrodes, then characterised with voltage sweeps at different frequencies.
works.method_zh: 在培养基上培养香菇菌丝体，干燥后再补水并连接电极，用不同频率的电压扫描测量其特性。

works.title: A scalable pipeline for designing reconfigurable organisms (Xenobots)
works.description: An evolutionary algorithm designed body shapes in simulation, and the best designs were built by hand from frog skin and heart cells; the sub-millimetre 'Xenobots' walked, pushed pellets and healed after cuts.
works.description_zh: 进化算法在模拟中设计身体形态，研究者再用青蛙的皮肤细胞和心肌细胞手工拼出最佳设计；这些不到一毫米的“Xenobots”会行走、推动小颗粒，被切开后还能愈合。
works.idea_en: A computer designs the body, living cells build it: the first organisms designed from scratch by AI.
works.idea_zh: 计算机设计身体，活细胞来建造：第一批由 AI 从零设计的生物体。
works.method: Designs evolved on a supercomputer were sculpted from Xenopus laevis stem-cell tissue with microsurgery tools; beating cardiomyocytes provided propulsion.
works.method_zh: 在超级计算机上进化出的设计，用显微外科工具从非洲爪蟾干细胞组织中雕刻出来，跳动的心肌细胞提供推进力。

works.title: A cellular platform for the development of synthetic living machines (Xenobots 2.0)
works.description: Frog stem cells left to self-assemble formed spherical Xenobots that swim with hair-like cilia, work together to gather debris into piles and can record an encounter with a colour-changing memory protein.
works.description_zh: 让青蛙干细胞自行聚集，形成用纤毛游动的球形 Xenobots；它们能协作把碎屑聚成堆，还能用会变色的记忆蛋白记录曾经接触过的东西。
works.idea_en: Let cells self-organise the body, then program behaviour on top.
works.idea_zh: 让细胞自己组织出身体，再在其上编程行为。
works.method: Xenopus animal-cap cells aggregate into spheroids covered in motile cilia; mRNA for the photoconvertible protein EosFP serves as a one-bit memory of blue-light exposure.
works.method_zh: 非洲爪蟾动物帽细胞聚集成表面布满可运动纤毛的球体；可光转换蛋白 EosFP 的 mRNA 作为记录是否受过蓝光照射的一比特记忆。

works.title: Kinematic self-replication in reconfigurable organisms
works.description: Xenobots swimming among loose frog stem cells pushed them into piles that matured into new Xenobots; an AI-designed 'Pac-Man' shape kept this replication going for more generations.
works.description_zh: 在散落的青蛙干细胞中游动的 Xenobots 把细胞推成堆，这些堆会长成新的 Xenobots；AI 设计的“吃豆人”形状让这种复制能延续更多代。
works.idea_en: A new way for life to reproduce: by building copies from loose parts, like a machine would.
works.idea_zh: 一种新的繁殖方式：像机器那样，用散落的零件拼出自己的副本。
works.method: Evolutionary search in simulation found body shapes that maximise pile-making; the designs were tested in dishes of dissociated Xenopus cells.
works.method_zh: 在模拟中用进化搜索找到最能“堆细胞”的身体形状，再在含有分散爪蟾细胞的培养皿中测试。

works.title: Anthrobots: Motile living biobots self-construct from adult human somatic progenitor seed cells
works.description: Single adult human airway cells grown in a new environment built themselves into moving multicellular bots; placed on a scratched layer of human neurons, they helped the gap close.
works.description_zh: 单个成人气管细胞在新的培养环境中自行长成会移动的多细胞机器人；把它们放在被划伤的人类神经元层上，它们能帮助伤口愈合。
works.idea_en: Our own cells, freed from the body plan, can become new kinds of creatures.
works.idea_zh: 我们自己的细胞，一旦脱离身体的蓝图，就能变成新的生命形态。
works.method: Human tracheal epithelial cells were grown as organoids in Matrigel and then in low-viscosity medium, which turned their cilia outward so they could swim.
works.method_zh: 把人类气管上皮细胞先在 Matrigel 中培养成类器官，再转入低黏度培养基，使纤毛朝外，从而能够游动。

works.title: Biohybrid robot powered by an antagonistic pair of skeletal muscle tissues
works.description: A robotic finger joint bent back and forth for a week, driven by two lab-grown rat muscles working against each other like biceps and triceps, and picked up and placed a ring.
works.description_zh: 一个机器人手指关节由两束实验室培养的大鼠肌肉驱动，它们像肱二头肌和肱三头肌一样相互拮抗，让手指来回弯曲了一周，还能拾起并放下一个圆环。
works.idea_en: Copy the body's paired-muscle layout to make living actuators last.
works.idea_zh: 照搬身体里成对肌肉的布局，让活体执行器更持久。
works.method: Myoblast-laden hydrogel sheets matured into muscle on a resin skeleton; electrical stimulation contracted each side in turn while the opposite muscle kept tension.
works.method_zh: 含成肌细胞的水凝胶片在树脂骨架上成熟为肌肉，电刺激轮流收缩两侧肌肉，另一侧则保持张力。

works.title: Living skin on a robot
works.description: A robotic finger was covered in cultured human skin that stretched as it bent, repelled water like real skin and healed a cut when a collagen bandage was applied.
works.description_zh: 一根机器人手指被覆盖上培养的人体皮肤：弯曲时皮肤随之伸展，像真皮肤一样防水，被割伤后贴上胶原“创可贴”还能愈合。
works.idea_en: A robot that can be wounded and heal, with skin like ours.
works.idea_zh: 一台有着和我们一样的皮肤、会受伤也会愈合的机器人。
works.method: The finger was dipped into a solution of collagen and human dermal fibroblasts that shrank to fit, then seeded with keratinocytes to form an epidermis.
works.method_zh: 把手指浸入含胶原和人真皮成纤维细胞的溶液中，溶液收缩贴合后，再接种角质形成细胞形成表皮。

works.title: Perforation-type anchors inspired by skin ligament for robotic face covered with living skin
works.description: A small robotic face covered with lab-grown skin that is held on by anchors through tiny holes, so the skin moves with the face and forms a smile.
works.description_zh: 一张覆盖着实验室培养皮肤的小型机器人脸，皮肤通过穿过微孔的“锚”固定，因此能随脸部移动，做出微笑。
works.idea_en: Anchor living tissue the way ligaments do, so a machine can wear a face.
works.idea_zh: 像韧带那样固定活组织，让机器可以“长”出一张脸。
works.method: V-shaped perforations in the robot's surface fill with collagen gel and fibroblasts that anchor the dermis; the face is moved by actuators beneath.
works.method_zh: 机器人表面的 V 形穿孔中填入胶原凝胶和成纤维细胞，把真皮层锚定；面部由下方的执行器驱动。

works.title: Biohybrid bipedal robot powered by skeletal muscle tissue
works.description: A small two-legged robot walks and turns underwater, each leg pulled by a strip of lab-grown muscle that contracts when stimulated.
works.description_zh: 一台小型双足机器人能在水中行走和转弯，每条腿都由一条实验室培养的肌肉拉动，肌肉在刺激下收缩。
works.idea_en: Human-like walking with real muscle, not motors.
works.idea_zh: 用真正的肌肉而不是电机，实现类人的行走。
works.method: Cultured skeletal muscle tissue attached to a flexible silicone body with a float; electrodes in the water trigger alternate leg contractions.
works.method_zh: 培养的骨骼肌组织连接在带浮子的柔性硅胶身体上，水中的电极交替刺激两条腿收缩。

works.title: Biohybrid hand actuated by multiple human muscle tissues
works.description: An 18-centimetre hand whose fingers bend and pinch, powered by bundles of rolled human muscle tissue, a jump in scale from earlier millimetre-sized biohybrids.
works.description_zh: 一只长 18 厘米的手，由卷成束的人体肌肉组织驱动，手指能弯曲、能捏合，比以往毫米级的生物混合体在尺度上跨了一大步。
works.idea_en: Bundle thin muscles like sushi rolls to reach the size of a human hand.
works.idea_zh: 像卷寿司一样把细肌肉卷成束，做到人手的尺寸。
works.method: Thin sheets of cultured human muscle were rolled into 'MuMuTAs' (multiple muscle tissue actuators) and attached as tendons to a 3D-printed hand, then electrically stimulated.
works.method_zh: 把培养的人体肌肉薄片卷成“MuMuTA”（多肌肉组织执行器），作为肌腱连到 3D 打印的手上，再通过电刺激驱动。

works.title: A tissue-engineered jellyfish with biomimetic propulsion (Medusoid)
works.description: A flat, eight-armed 'Medusoid' made of silicone and rat heart muscle cells swims like a juvenile moon jellyfish when an electric field makes the cells contract.
works.description_zh: 由硅胶和大鼠心肌细胞做成的扁平八臂“Medusoid”，在电场刺激细胞收缩时，像幼年海月水母一样游动。
works.idea_en: Reverse-engineer an animal by rebuilding it from different cells.
works.idea_zh: 用另一种细胞重建一种动物，以此反向理解它。
works.method: Rat cardiomyocytes were patterned on a silicone sheet to copy the muscle alignment of Aurelia aurita; field stimulation produces synchronous strokes.
works.method_zh: 把大鼠心肌细胞按海月水母的肌肉排列图案培养在硅胶片上，用电场刺激产生同步的划水动作。

works.title: Phototactic guidance of a tissue-engineered soft-robotic ray
works.description: A 16-millimetre robotic stingray with a gold skeleton and 200,000 genetically modified rat heart cells swims and follows pulses of light through an obstacle course.
works.description_zh: 一只长 16 毫米的机器人鳐鱼，有金质骨架和 20 万个经基因改造的大鼠心肌细胞，能游动，并跟随光脉冲穿过障碍赛道。
works.idea_en: Steer a living machine with light by making its muscle light-sensitive.
works.idea_zh: 让肌肉对光敏感，就能用光来驾驶一台活的机器。
works.method: Optogenetically engineered cardiomyocytes on an elastomer body contract in response to blue light; left and right fins are triggered by different light frequencies.
works.method_zh: 经光遗传改造的心肌细胞附着在弹性体身体上，对蓝光产生收缩；左右鳍由不同频率的光分别触发。

works.title: An autonomously swimming biohybrid fish designed with human cardiac biophysics
works.description: A paper-and-gelatin fish powered by two layers of human stem-cell-derived heart muscle swims on its own for more than 100 days, with a built-in pacemaker node.
works.description_zh: 一条用纸和明胶做成的鱼，由两层人类干细胞来源的心肌驱动，内置起搏节点，能自主游动 100 多天。
works.idea_en: Build a heart's feedback loop into a body, and it keeps itself going.
works.idea_zh: 把心脏的反馈回路做进一个身体，它就能自己运转下去。
works.method: Human cardiomyocytes on each side of the tail stretch-activate each other in turn, while a separate node of cells sets the rhythm.
works.method_zh: 尾部两侧的人类心肌细胞相互拉伸、轮流激活，另有一团细胞充当节律起搏器。

works.title: Development of miniaturized walking biological machines
works.description: Half-centimetre 3D-printed hydrogel cantilevers covered with beating rat heart cells 'walked' across a surface, the first of the Illinois bio-bots.
works.description_zh: 半厘米长的 3D 打印水凝胶悬臂上覆盖着跳动的大鼠心肌细胞，能在表面上“行走”，这是伊利诺伊“生物机器人”的第一代。
works.idea_en: Print a skeleton, seed it with cells, and let the heartbeat become a gait.
works.idea_zh: 打印一副骨架，种上细胞，让心跳变成步态。
works.method: A stereolithography-printed asymmetric hydrogel beam with a layer of cardiomyocytes bends with each beat, moving the bot forward.
works.method_zh: 用光固化打印的非对称水凝胶梁上覆盖一层心肌细胞，每次搏动都让它弯曲，从而向前移动。

works.title: Three-dimensionally printed biological machines powered by skeletal muscle
works.description: Bio-bots powered by a ring of skeletal muscle move only when stimulated by electrical pulses, giving the first on-command control of walking biobots.
works.description_zh: 由一圈骨骼肌驱动的生物机器人，只在电脉冲刺激下才移动，首次实现了“按指令行走”的生物机器人控制。
works.idea_en: Switch from heart to skeletal muscle so the machine moves only when told.
works.idea_zh: 从心肌换成骨骼肌，让机器只在被命令时才动。
works.method: Mouse myoblasts in a hydrogel ring differentiate into muscle around 3D-printed pillars; the pulse frequency sets the walking speed.
works.method_zh: 小鼠成肌细胞在水凝胶环中围绕 3D 打印的立柱分化成肌肉，电脉冲频率决定行走速度。

works.title: Remote control of muscle-driven miniature robots with battery-free wireless optoelectronics
works.description: Muscle-powered biobots carry a tiny wireless LED circuit on their backs; flashing the light contracts light-sensitive muscle, so each bot can be steered and turned remotely.
works.description_zh: 肌肉驱动的生物机器人背上带着一块微型无线 LED 电路，LED 闪烁时，光敏肌肉收缩，因此每个机器人都能被远程转向和操控。
works.idea_en: Combine living muscle with battery-free electronics for untethered control.
works.idea_zh: 把活肌肉和无电池电子器件结合，实现无线控制。
works.method: Optogenetic skeletal muscle is paired with a soft, wirelessly powered micro-LED module from John Rogers' group; radio frequency powers the lights.
works.method_zh: 光遗传骨骼肌与 John Rogers 团队的柔性无线供电微型 LED 模块结合，射频为 LED 供电。

works.title: A self-propelled biohybrid swimmer at low Reynolds number
works.description: A sperm-like swimmer with a polymer tail and a head of heart cells swims on its own, as neighbouring cells coordinate their beating along the tail.
works.description_zh: 一个像精子的游泳机器人，头部是心肌细胞，尾巴是聚合物；相邻细胞沿着尾巴协调搏动，让它自主游动。
works.idea_en: Let cells coordinate among themselves through the body's mechanics.
works.idea_zh: 让细胞通过身体的力学彼此协调。
works.method: Cardiomyocytes grow on a flexible PDMS filament; mechanical coupling synchronises their contractions into a travelling wave.
works.method_zh: 心肌细胞生长在柔性 PDMS 细丝上，机械耦合让它们的收缩同步为一个行波。

works.title: Neuromuscular actuation of biohybrid motile bots
works.description: A swimmer whose muscle is driven by living motor neurons grown from stem cells, so the nerve cells, not an external pulse, make it move.
works.description_zh: 一个游泳机器人，其肌肉由干细胞培养出的活运动神经元驱动；让它动起来的是神经细胞，而不是外部电脉冲。
works.idea_en: Give a biohybrid robot its own nerves.
works.idea_zh: 给生物混合机器人装上它自己的神经。
works.method: An optogenetic neural cluster from mouse stem cells innervates skeletal muscle on a two-tailed scaffold; light activates the neurons, which drive the muscle.
works.method_zh: 来自小鼠干细胞的光遗传神经元团支配双尾支架上的骨骼肌，光激活神经元，神经元再驱动肌肉。

works.title: Optogenetic skeletal muscle-powered adaptive biological machines
works.description: Biobots with light-sensitive muscle walk when blue light pulses, and their muscle gets stronger with repeated 'exercise'.
works.description_zh: 装有光敏肌肉的生物机器人在蓝光闪烁时行走，而且肌肉会在反复“锻炼”后变得更强。
works.idea_en: Machines that train and grow stronger, like athletes.
works.idea_zh: 像运动员一样会训练、会变强的机器。
works.method: Channelrhodopsin-expressing mouse myoblasts form muscle rings on hydrogel skeletons; light pulses set the gait and repeated stimulation increases force.
works.method_zh: 表达通道视紫红质的小鼠成肌细胞在水凝胶骨架上形成肌肉环，光脉冲决定步态，反复刺激会提高收缩力。

works.title: Soft erythrocyte-based bacterial microswimmers for cargo delivery
works.description: Red blood cells loaded with drugs and magnetic particles are pushed along by attached E. coli bacteria, steered by magnets, and can be destroyed on command with light.
works.description_zh: 装载药物和磁性颗粒的红细胞由附着的大肠杆菌推动前进，用磁场引导方向，还能用光按指令销毁。
works.idea_en: Use bacteria as motors and blood cells as soft vehicles for robots inside the body.
works.idea_zh: 把细菌当马达、把血细胞当柔软的载具，做体内机器人。
works.method: Engineered E. coli bind to red blood cells via biotin–avidin; superparamagnetic nanoparticles enable magnetic steering and near-infrared light triggers self-destruction.
works.method_zh: 工程大肠杆菌通过生物素-亲和素结合到红细胞上；超顺磁纳米颗粒用于磁场导航，近红外光触发自毁。

works.title: Aplysia californica as a novel source of material for biohybrid robots and organic machines
works.description: A 3D-printed crawler moves using the buccal muscle of the California sea slug, which tolerates wide temperature ranges and is built from biodegradable parts.
works.description_zh: 一台 3D 打印的爬行机器人，利用加州海兔的口球肌肉移动；这种肌肉能耐受较大的温度范围，机器人本身也由可降解材料制成。
works.idea_en: Pick a tough animal whose tissue can survive outside the lab.
works.idea_zh: 挑一种组织能在实验室外存活的强韧动物。
works.method: The I2 buccal muscle of Aplysia is attached to a printed polymer body and stimulated electrically; later versions use the animal's own nerve ganglia as controllers.
works.method_zh: 把海兔的 I2 口球肌接在打印的聚合物身体上，用电刺激驱动；后续版本用动物自身的神经节作为控制器。

works.title: Remote radio control of insect flight
works.description: Large flower beetles fitted with a radio backpack could be made to take off, turn and stop flying on command, by stimulating their brain and flight muscles.
works.description_zh: 背着无线电“背包”的大型花金龟，可以通过刺激大脑和飞行肌肉，按指令起飞、转弯和停止飞行。
works.idea_en: Instead of building a flying robot, steer an insect that already flies.
works.idea_zh: 与其造一台会飞的机器人，不如操控一只本来就会飞的昆虫。
works.method: Electrodes implanted in the optic lobes and basalar muscles of Mecynorrhina torquata connect to a microcontroller and radio receiver on the back.
works.method_zh: 在花金龟的视叶和基节肌中植入电极，连接到背上的微控制器和无线接收器。

works.title: Integration of body-mounted ultrasoft organic solar cell on cyborg insects with intact mobility
works.description: Madagascar hissing cockroaches carry a 3D-printed backpack and a 4-micrometre-thick solar film on their abdomen, which recharges the battery that steers them without stopping them from moving or righting themselves.
works.description_zh: 马达加斯加发声蟑螂背着 3D 打印的背包，腹部贴有 4 微米厚的太阳能薄膜，为操控它们的电池充电，且不妨碍它们行动和翻身。
works.idea_en: Design electronics thin enough that the animal's own body still works.
works.idea_zh: 把电子器件做得足够薄，让动物自身的身体照常运作。
works.method: An ultrathin organic photovoltaic film with adhesive and non-adhesive stripes follows abdominal segments; a wireless module stimulates the cerci to steer.
works.method_zh: 超薄有机光伏薄膜以粘贴与不粘贴交替的条带贴合腹节，无线模块刺激尾须来转向。

works.title: Cyborg insect factory: automatic assembly for insect-computer hybrid robots
works.description: A robot arm guided by computer vision attaches electronic backpacks to cockroaches in about a minute each, turning cyborg-insect assembly into a production line.
works.description_zh: 一条由计算机视觉引导的机械臂，大约一分钟就能给一只蟑螂装好电子背包，把赛博昆虫的组装变成流水线。
works.idea_en: Mass-producing cyborg animals changes the questions from 'can we' to 'should we, at scale'.
works.idea_zh: 当赛博动物可以量产，问题就从“能不能”变成了“该不该大规模做”。
works.method: A deep-learning vision system locates the insect's body segments and a robot arm mounts a backpack whose electrodes stimulate the pronotum for steering.
works.method_zh: 深度学习视觉系统定位昆虫体节，机械臂安装背包，其电极刺激前胸背板以控制方向。

works.title: Swarm navigation of cyborg-insects in unknown obstructed soft terrain
works.description: A group of cyborg cockroaches navigates as a swarm over rough terrain, with an algorithm that lets stuck insects be helped free by others.
works.description_zh: 一群赛博蟑螂以群体方式穿越崎岖地形，算法让被卡住的个体可以被同伴“帮”出来。
works.idea_en: Combine animal agility with swarm algorithms rather than controlling each insect tightly.
works.idea_zh: 结合动物的灵活性与群体算法，而不是对每只昆虫严密控制。
works.method: Each cockroach carries a backpack with sensors and stimulators; a leader–follower algorithm uses the insects' natural behaviours and only nudges them occasionally.
works.method_zh: 每只蟑螂背着带传感器和刺激器的背包，领航-跟随算法利用昆虫的天然行为，只在必要时轻微干预。

works.title: Low-power microelectronics embedded in live jellyfish enhance propulsion
works.description: A small pacemaker attached to moon jellyfish made them swim up to nearly three times faster while using only a little extra energy, without apparent stress to the animal.
works.description_zh: 给海月水母装上一个小型起搏器，可以让它们游速提高到近三倍，额外能耗很少，也看不出明显的应激反应。
works.idea_en: Augment an animal that is already an efficient swimmer instead of building a new robot.
works.idea_zh: 强化一个本就擅长游泳的动物，而不是另造一台机器人。
works.method: A self-contained microelectronic stimulator with electrodes in the swimming muscle of Aurelia aurita sets a faster pulse rate than the animal's own.
works.method_zh: 在海月水母的游泳肌中插入电极，由一个自带电源的微电子刺激器设定比其自然节律更快的搏动频率。

works.title: Electromechanical enhancement of live jellyfish for ocean exploration
works.description: Live jellyfish wear a 3D-printed streamlined 'hat' that can carry sensors, and a pacemaker makes them swim faster, as a step toward jellyfish that sample the deep ocean.
works.description_zh: 活水母戴上一个可装载传感器的 3D 打印流线型“帽子”，起搏器让它们游得更快，朝着用水母采样深海的方向迈进一步。
works.idea_en: Recruit animals as ocean sensors that power themselves.
works.idea_zh: 让动物成为自带能源的海洋传感器。
works.method: A 3D-printed forebody reduces drag and holds a payload; swimming was tested in a tall vertical tank with the electronic stimulator.
works.method_zh: 3D 打印的前体降低阻力并承载载荷；在高竖直水槽中与电刺激器一起测试游动。

works.title: Necrobotics: Biotic materials as ready-to-use actuators
works.description: Dead wolf spiders turned into grippers: injecting air into the body extends the legs, and releasing it lets them close to pick up objects heavier than the spider.
works.description_zh: 把死去的狼蛛变成夹爪：向身体里注入空气时腿会张开，放气时腿会合拢，能抓起比蜘蛛本身更重的物体。
works.idea_en: A dead body can still be a finished, working machine.
works.idea_zh: 死去的身体，仍可以是一台现成的、能工作的机器。
works.method: Spiders move legs hydraulically; a needle glued into the cephalothorax connects to a syringe that pressurises the body to open the legs.
works.method_zh: 蜘蛛靠液压驱动腿部；把针头粘进头胸部并连到注射器，给身体加压让腿张开。

works.title: Smellicopter: a bio-hybrid odor-guided autonomous palm-sized air vehicle
works.description: A palm-sized drone uses a live antenna from a hawk moth as its nose, turning toward an odour source and avoiding obstacles on its own.
works.description_zh: 一架手掌大小的无人机把烟草天蛾的活触角当作鼻子，能自主转向气味源并避开障碍。
works.idea_en: Borrow an insect's sense organ, which beats any artificial sensor, and put it on a machine.
works.idea_zh: 借用昆虫的感觉器官（它比任何人造传感器都灵敏），装到机器上。
works.method: An excised Manduca sexta antenna stays alive for hours between electrodes; its signal spikes when it detects odour, and the drone's plume-tracking algorithm uses that signal.
works.method_zh: 摘下的烟草天蛾触角夹在电极之间可存活数小时；闻到气味时信号会突增，无人机的羽流追踪算法据此行动。

works.title: Explosive sensing with insect-based biorobots
works.description: Locusts fitted with electrodes in their brain and a small backpack could tell apart the vapours of different explosives within milliseconds, and did so while moving on a small cart.
works.description_zh: 大脑中植入电极、背着小背包的蝗虫，能在几毫秒内分辨不同爆炸物的气味，而且在小车上移动时也能做到。
works.idea_en: Read an insect's brain as a chemical detector.
works.idea_zh: 把昆虫的大脑读成一台化学探测器。
works.method: Recordings from the antennal lobe of Schistocerca americana were decoded; a heat-producing tattoo on the wings was proposed to steer them.
works.method_zh: 解码美洲沙漠蝗触角叶的神经记录；研究者还提出用翅膀上的发热“纹身”来引导它们。

works.title: Odour-tracking capability of a silkmoth driving a mobile robot
works.description: A male silkmoth walks on a ball mounted on a small wheeled robot, and its steps drive the robot toward a female pheromone source, even when the robot's response is delayed or biased.
works.description_zh: 一只雄性家蚕蛾在装在小型轮式机器人上的球上行走，它的步伐驱动机器人驶向雌蛾信息素源；即使机器人的响应被延迟或偏转，它也能找到。
works.idea_en: Let an insect drive a vehicle to see how its brain adapts.
works.idea_zh: 让昆虫驾驶车辆，观察它的大脑如何适应。
works.method: The moth's walking on a trackball is read by optical sensors and converted into wheel speed; delays and turning bias are introduced to test adaptation.
works.method_zh: 光学传感器读取蛾在追踪球上的行走，并转换成车轮速度；再人为加入延迟和转向偏差来测试其适应能力。

works.title: RoboRoach
works.description: A consumer kit that lets students attach a Bluetooth backpack to a cockroach's antennae and turn it left or right with a smartphone app.
works.description_zh: 一款面向公众的套件，学生可以把蓝牙背包接到蟑螂触角上，用手机应用让它左转或右转。
works.idea_en: A cyborg-insect kit as a way to teach neuroscience, and a public test of where the ethical line lies.
works.idea_zh: 一个用来教授神经科学的赛博昆虫套件，也是对伦理边界的一次公开测试。
works.method: Wires inserted into the antennae deliver small pulses that the cockroach perceives as touching an obstacle, so it turns the other way.
works.method_zh: 插入触角的导线发出微小电脉冲，蟑螂会感觉像碰到了障碍物，于是转向另一边。

works.title: flora robotica — mixed societies of symbiotic robot–plant bio-hybrids
works.description: An EU project in which robots with lights and sensors steer the growth of climbing plants along braided scaffolds, so robots and plants shape architecture together.
works.description_zh: 一个欧盟项目：带灯光和传感器的机器人引导攀缘植物沿编织支架生长，机器人与植物一起塑造建筑。
works.idea_en: Architecture that is grown by plants and steered by robots over months.
works.idea_zh: 由植物生长、由机器人在数月间引导的建筑。
works.method: Distributed robot nodes emit blue light to attract plant growth toward chosen directions and sense plant position; plants in turn stiffen the scaffold.
works.method_zh: 分布式机器人节点发出蓝光，引导植物朝选定方向生长并感知植物位置；植物反过来加固支架。

paper.venue: IEEE Symposium Series on Computational Intelligence (SSCI) 2015

works.title: Toward self-growing soft robots inspired by plant roots and based on additive manufacturing technologies
works.description: A robot root that follows IIT's earlier Plantoid project and moves into soil by growing: a 3D printer in its tip lays down new material, so it lengthens from the tip like a real root.
works.description_zh: 一根延续 IIT 早期 Plantoid 项目、靠生长钻入土壤的机器人根：尖端里的 3D 打印机不断铺设新材料，让它像真正的根一样从尖端伸长。
works.idea_en: Take plants as the model for robots that grow instead of walk.
works.idea_zh: 以植物为原型，让机器人靠生长而不是行走来移动。
works.method: A plant-inspired robot, not a biohybrid: a tip-mounted additive-manufacturing mechanism deposits thermoplastic filament layer by layer as the root advances.
works.method_zh: 这是受植物启发的机器人，而非生物混合体：尖端的增材制造机构随着根的前进逐层沉积热塑性丝材。

works.title: Long-term, stochastic editing of regenerative anatomy via targeting endogenous bioelectric gradients (two-headed planaria)
works.description: Flatworms cut while their cell-to-cell electrical connections were briefly blocked regrew with a head at both ends; in many others the change stayed hidden and appeared only when they were cut again, with no change to their genome.
works.description_zh: 在短暂阻断细胞间电连接的情况下切开扁形虫，一部分会在两端都长出头；另一些虫看起来正常，但再切一次时才显露出双头，而它们的基因组并没有改变。
works.idea_en: Body shape is stored partly in a bioelectric pattern that can be rewritten, like memory.
works.idea_zh: 身体的形状部分储存在一种可以改写的生物电图式里，就像记忆。
works.method: Planarian fragments regenerated in 8-OH-octanol, a gap-junction blocker; their bioelectric state was imaged with voltage-sensitive dyes and the worms were re-cut in plain water.
works.method_zh: 让涡虫片段在缝隙连接阻断剂 8-OH-辛醇中再生，用电压敏感染料成像其生物电状态，再在清水中重新切割。

works.title: Acute multidrug delivery via a wearable bioreactor facilitates long-term limb regeneration in adult Xenopus laevis (BioDome)
works.description: Adult frogs, which normally cannot regrow limbs, wore a silicone 'BioDome' with a five-drug cocktail over a fresh amputation for just 24 hours, and over the next 18 months regrew a largely functional leg.
works.description_zh: 成年青蛙本来无法再生肢体；研究者在截肢伤口上给它们戴一个装有五种药物的硅胶“BioDome”，只戴 24 小时，之后 18 个月里它们长出了功能基本完整的腿。
works.idea_en: A short, well-timed nudge from a wearable device can start a body's own long-term growth program.
works.idea_zh: 可穿戴装置在恰当时机轻推一下，就能启动身体自己的长期生长程序。
works.method: A wearable silk-hydrogel bioreactor delivers growth and anti-inflammatory compounds to the wound for 24 hours; regeneration is tracked by imaging, micro-CT and sensory tests.
works.method_zh: 可穿戴的丝蛋白水凝胶生物反应器向伤口递送生长因子和抗炎药物 24 小时，再用成像、显微 CT 和感觉测试追踪再生。

works.title: Technological Approach to Mind Everywhere (TAME): an experimentally-grounded framework for understanding diverse bodies and minds
works.description: A theoretical framework that treats cognition as a continuum across cells, tissues, organisms, swarms and hybrids such as Xenobots and cyborgs, judged by what goals a system can pursue.
works.description_zh: 一个理论框架，把认知看成从细胞、组织、生物体、群体到 Xenobots 和赛博格等混合体的连续谱，以一个系统能追求什么样的目标来衡量它。
works.idea_en: Ask not whether something has a mind, but how large a goal it can pursue and how we can talk to it.
works.idea_zh: 不问某物有没有心智，而问它能追求多大的目标、我们能怎样和它“对话”。
works.method: Draws on regeneration, bioelectricity and biohybrid experiments to define a scale of 'cognitive light cones' and experimental tests for agency in any substrate.
works.method_zh: 借助再生、生物电和生物混合体实验，定义“认知光锥”的尺度，以及在任何载体中检验能动性的实验方法。

works.title: EcoBot-III: a robot with guts
works.description: A robot powered by 48 microbial fuel cells that collected its own food and water from an arena, digested it with bacteria, excreted the waste and kept itself running for seven days.
works.description_zh: 一台由 48 个微生物燃料电池供能的机器人，它从场地中自己收集食物和水，用细菌消化，再排出废物，靠自己连续运行了七天。
works.idea_en: A robot that eats, digests and excretes, powered by the metabolism of its microbes.
works.idea_zh: 一台会吃、会消化、会排泄的机器人，由体内微生物的新陈代谢供能。
works.method: Anaerobic bacteria in a stack of microbial fuel cells oxidise organic feedstock and release electrons to the anodes; a pump circulates food, water and waste like a digestive tract.
works.method_zh: 微生物燃料电池堆中的厌氧细菌氧化有机原料，把电子释放到阳极上；泵像消化道一样循环输送食物、水和废物。

works.title: Molecular computation of solutions to combinatorial problems
works.description: Adleman solved a seven-city Hamiltonian path problem in a test tube: DNA strands coding cities and roads combined in all possible ways, and lab steps filtered out the one valid route.
works.description_zh: Adleman 在试管里解出了一个七城市的哈密顿路径问题：编码城市和道路的 DNA 链以所有可能的方式结合，再通过实验步骤筛出唯一有效的路线。
works.idea_en: Chemistry can compute by trying every answer at once in parallel.
works.idea_zh: 化学可以通过同时尝试所有答案来进行计算。
works.method: Oligonucleotides for vertices and edges were ligated; PCR, gel electrophoresis and affinity purification selected paths of the right length that visit every vertex.
works.method_zh: 用代表顶点和边的寡核苷酸连接成路径，再用 PCR、凝胶电泳和亲和纯化筛选出长度正确、经过每个顶点的路径。

works.title: Neural network computation with DNA strand displacement cascades
works.description: A test-tube neural network of 112 DNA strands played a 'mind-reading' game: given partial answers to yes/no questions, it recalled which of four scientists the answers matched.
works.description_zh: 一个由 112 条 DNA 链组成的试管神经网络玩“读心”游戏：给出几道是非题的部分答案，它能回忆出这些答案对应四位科学家中的哪一位。
works.idea_en: Neural computation can be written in molecules, with no electronics at all.
works.idea_zh: 神经计算可以完全用分子写成，不需要任何电子器件。
works.method: Seesaw gates built from DNA strand displacement implement weighted sums and thresholds of a Hopfield-type network; fluorescence reports the output.
works.method_zh: 用 DNA 链置换构成的“跷跷板”门实现 Hopfield 型网络的加权求和与阈值，由荧光读出结果。

works.title: Scaling up molecular pattern recognition with DNA-based winner-take-all neural networks
works.description: A DNA neural network recognised 'molecular handwriting': handwritten digits encoded as mixtures of DNA strands were classified correctly in the test tube.
works.description_zh: 一个 DNA 神经网络识别“分子手写体”：把手写数字编码为 DNA 链的混合物，它能在试管中对其正确分类。
works.idea_en: Molecules that recognise patterns could let materials and cells classify their surroundings.
works.idea_zh: 能识别图案的分子，也许能让材料和细胞对周围环境进行分类。
works.method: Each 10×10 digit image maps to 20 of 100 DNA strands; weight multiplication, summation and a winner-take-all layer decide between two digit classes, reported by fluorescence.
works.method_zh: 每幅 10×10 的数字图像对应 100 条 DNA 链中的 20 条；权重乘法、求和和“赢家通吃”层判断属于哪一类数字，并以荧光显示。

works.title: Supervised learning in DNA neural networks
works.description: A DNA neural network learned from examples inside the test tube: training molecules stored weights, and the network then classified new molecular patterns without a computer calculating the weights first.
works.description_zh: 一个 DNA 神经网络在试管中从示例中学习：训练分子储存权重，网络随后能对新的分子图案分类，无需先用计算机算出权重。
works.idea_en: Molecules that can learn, not only execute a program we give them.
works.idea_zh: 分子不仅能执行我们给的程序，还能自己学习。
works.method: Training examples activate DNA strands that set molecular weights in place; test patterns are then processed by the same strand-displacement network.
works.method_zh: 训练样本激活 DNA 链并就地设定分子权重，测试图案随后由同一个链置换网络处理。

works.title: Next-generation digital information storage in DNA
works.description: Church's team wrote a 53,000-word book, with images and a JavaScript program, into DNA and read it back, storing about 5.5 petabits per cubic millimetre.
works.description_zh: Church 团队把一本 5.3 万词、带图片和 JavaScript 程序的书写进 DNA 再读出来，存储密度约为每立方毫米 5.5 拍比特。
works.idea_en: DNA is the densest, longest-lasting storage medium we know.
works.idea_zh: DNA 是我们已知密度最高、保存最久的存储介质。
works.method: Bits were mapped to bases (one bit per base), split into 96-bit blocks with addresses, synthesised on microarrays and read back by next-generation sequencing.
works.method_zh: 把比特映射到碱基（每个碱基一比特），切成带地址的 96 比特数据块，用微阵列合成，再用二代测序读回。

works.title: Towards practical, high-capacity, low-maintenance information storage in synthesized DNA
works.description: All 154 Shakespeare sonnets, a PDF of Watson and Crick's paper, a photo and an audio clip of Martin Luther King's 'I have a dream' were stored in DNA and recovered without errors.
works.description_zh: 莎士比亚全部 154 首十四行诗、Watson 与 Crick 论文的 PDF、一张照片和马丁·路德·金《我有一个梦想》的音频片段被存入 DNA，并无差错地恢复。
works.idea_en: Design the code around the medium's weaknesses and DNA becomes a reliable archive.
works.idea_zh: 围绕介质的弱点设计编码，DNA 就能成为可靠的档案库。
works.method: Data were converted to base-3 and encoded so that no base repeats, avoiding sequencing errors; overlapping fragments gave fourfold redundancy.
works.method_zh: 把数据转成三进制，并以不出现相同碱基连续重复的方式编码以避开测序错误；重叠片段提供四倍冗余。

works.title: CRISPR–Cas encoding of a digital movie into the genomes of a population of living bacteria
works.description: Frames of Eadweard Muybridge's galloping-horse film were written into the genomes of living E. coli over several days, and later read back from the bacterial population.
works.description_zh: Eadweard Muybridge 奔马影片的画面在几天内被逐帧写入活大肠杆菌的基因组，之后又从细菌群体中读了出来。
works.idea_en: Living cells can act as recorders that write their experience into DNA.
works.idea_zh: 活细胞可以充当记录器，把经历写进自己的 DNA。
works.method: Pixel values were encoded in short DNA snippets delivered frame by frame; the Cas1–Cas2 integrase stored them in order in the CRISPR array, so their order encodes time.
works.method_zh: 像素值编码进短 DNA 片段并逐帧导入，Cas1–Cas2 整合酶按顺序把它们存进 CRISPR 阵列，顺序即代表时间。

works.title: Random access in large-scale DNA data storage
works.description: More than 200 MB, including an OK Go music video and the Universal Declaration of Human Rights in 100 languages, were stored in DNA, and individual files could be retrieved without reading everything.
works.description_zh: 超过 200 MB 的数据被存入 DNA，包括 OK Go 的音乐视频和 100 种语言的《世界人权宣言》，而且可以单独取出某个文件，不必读取全部数据。
works.idea_en: DNA storage becomes usable when you can open one file without reading the whole library.
works.idea_zh: 只有能单独打开一个文件而不必读完整座图书馆，DNA 存储才真正可用。
works.method: Each file's strands carry a primer pair used as an address; PCR amplifies only the requested file before sequencing, with error-correcting codes.
works.method_zh: 每个文件的 DNA 链带有一对引物作为地址，测序前用 PCR 只扩增所需文件，并配合纠错码。

works.title: DNA Fountain enables a robust and efficient storage architecture
works.description: An operating system, a short film, an Amazon gift card and a computer virus were stored in DNA with a fountain code, close to the theoretical maximum of bits per nucleotide.
works.description_zh: 一套操作系统、一部短片、一张亚马逊礼品卡和一个计算机病毒，用喷泉码存入 DNA，接近每个核苷酸所能承载比特数的理论上限。
works.idea_en: Borrow codes from video streaming to pack DNA almost to its limit.
works.idea_zh: 借用视频流媒体的编码，把 DNA 装到接近极限。
works.method: Luby-transform fountain codes create many droplets from the data; droplets that would give hard-to-synthesise sequences are discarded, and the rest are synthesised.
works.method_zh: 用 Luby 变换喷泉码从数据中生成大量“液滴”，丢弃会导致难以合成的序列的液滴，其余进行合成。

works.title: A DNA-of-things storage architecture to create materials with embedded memory
works.description: A 3D-printed Stanford bunny carries the file for printing itself in DNA inside its plastic; a piece cut from it can be used to print a new bunny, repeated over five generations.
works.description_zh: 一只 3D 打印的斯坦福兔子，塑料里含有打印它自己的文件（以 DNA 形式存储）；从中切下一小块，就能打印出新的兔子，重复了五代。
works.idea_en: Objects that carry their own blueprint, like living things do.
works.idea_zh: 像生物一样，物体可以携带自己的蓝图。
works.method: DNA encoding the STL file is sealed in silica nanobeads and mixed into the printing polymer; DNA is extracted from a fragment and sequenced.
works.method_zh: 把编码 STL 文件的 DNA 封装在二氧化硅纳米珠中并混入打印材料；从碎片中提取 DNA 进行测序。

works.title: Catalog: English Wikipedia in DNA
works.description: Catalog encoded the roughly 16 GB text of English Wikipedia into synthetic DNA using its own writing machine, and later built a platform for searching and computing over data stored in DNA.
works.description_zh: Catalog 用自己的写入机器把约 16 GB 的英文维基百科文本编码进合成 DNA，后来又开发了在 DNA 数据上搜索和计算的平台。
works.idea_en: Make DNA writing cheap by assembling data from prefabricated pieces, like movable type.
works.idea_zh: 像活字印刷一样，用预制片段拼出数据，让写 DNA 变得便宜。
works.method: Instead of synthesising each base, data are encoded as combinations of a library of pre-made DNA fragments joined by an inkjet-style machine.
works.method_zh: 不逐个合成碱基，而是把数据编码为预制 DNA 片段库的组合，由类似喷墨打印的机器拼接。

works.title: Biomemory DNA Card
works.description: Biomemory stores data in DNA and presented a credit-card-sized DNA storage cartridge for data-centre racks; in 2021 it stored the French declarations of human and women's rights in DNA for the Archives nationales.
works.description_zh: Biomemory 用 DNA 存储数据，推出了一种信用卡大小、面向数据中心机架的 DNA 存储卡；2021 年，它把法国《人权宣言》和《女权宣言》存入 DNA，交由法国国家档案馆保存。
works.idea_en: Package DNA as a familiar object, a card in a rack, so it fits existing infrastructure.
works.idea_zh: 把 DNA 包装成熟悉的物件（机架上的一张卡），让它融入现有的基础设施。
works.method: Data-encoding DNA is produced biologically with engineered cells rather than purely chemical synthesis, then dried and sealed in a cartridge.
works.method_zh: 用工程细胞以生物方式生产编码数据的 DNA，而不完全依赖化学合成，再干燥并封装进卡盒。

works.title: Genetic circuit design automation (Cello)
