works.description: Cello compiles a circuit written in Verilog, the language used for electronic chips, into a DNA sequence that makes E. coli perform that logic; 45 of the 60 circuits built worked as designed.
works.description_zh: Cello 把用 Verilog（设计芯片的语言）写的电路编译成 DNA 序列，让大肠杆菌执行对应的逻辑；构建的 60 个电路中有 45 个按设计工作。
works.idea_en: A programming language for living cells.
works.idea_zh: 一种为活细胞写程序的编程语言。
works.method: Logic is mapped to a library of characterised repressor-based NOT/NOR gates, assembled into a plasmid and inserted into bacteria.
works.method_zh: 把逻辑映射到一组已表征的、基于阻遏蛋白的 NOT/NOR 门，组装成质粒并导入细菌。

works.title: A synthetic oscillatory network of transcriptional regulators (the repressilator)
works.description: Three genes that switch each other off in a loop made E. coli cells blink green on and off, a genetic clock designed from scratch.
works.description_zh: 三个基因首尾相连、依次关闭下一个，让大肠杆菌周期性地发出绿色荧光，一个从零设计的基因时钟。
works.idea_en: Design a biological behaviour from parts, the way engineers design circuits.
works.idea_zh: 像工程师设计电路那样，用零件设计一种生物行为。
works.method: LacI, TetR and cI repressors are arranged in a ring of negative feedback on a plasmid; a GFP reporter shows the oscillation.
works.method_zh: LacI、TetR 和 cI 三个阻遏蛋白在质粒上组成负反馈环，由 GFP 报告振荡。

works.title: Construction of a genetic toggle switch in Escherichia coli
works.description: Two genes that repress each other gave bacteria a stable on/off state that can be flipped with a chemical or heat pulse and is remembered afterwards.
works.description_zh: 两个相互抑制的基因，让细菌有了稳定的开/关状态；用化学物质或热脉冲可以切换，切换后状态会被记住。
works.idea_en: Give a cell one bit of memory.
works.idea_zh: 给细胞一比特的存储器。
works.method: Two repressor–promoter pairs repress each other; transient IPTG or temperature signals switch the dominant state, read by a fluorescent reporter.
works.method_zh: 两对阻遏蛋白-启动子相互抑制，短暂的 IPTG 或温度信号切换主导状态，由荧光报告基因读出。

works.title: Folding DNA to create nanoscale shapes and patterns (DNA origami)
works.description: A long viral DNA strand was folded by about 200 short 'staple' strands into smiley faces, stars and a map of the Americas, each about 100 nanometres wide.
works.description_zh: 一条长的病毒 DNA 被约 200 条短“订书钉”链折叠成笑脸、星星和美洲地图，每个图形宽约 100 纳米。
works.idea_en: Design a shape on a computer and have molecules fold themselves into it.
works.idea_zh: 在电脑上设计形状，让分子自己折叠成这个形状。
works.method: Staple sequences are computed to bind distant parts of the M13 scaffold; mixing and cooling makes the structure self-assemble, imaged by atomic force microscopy.
works.method_zh: 计算出能把 M13 骨架链上相距较远的部分结合起来的订书钉序列；混合降温后结构自组装，并用原子力显微镜成像。

works.title: Diverse and robust molecular algorithms using reprogrammable DNA self-assembly
works.description: One set of 355 DNA tiles ran 21 different algorithms, such as counting, sorting and electing a leader, by choosing which tiles went into the tube; the result grows as a patterned DNA ribbon.
works.description_zh: 一套 355 块的 DNA 瓦片，通过选择放入试管的瓦片，运行了计数、排序、选“领导者”等 21 种算法；计算结果以带图案的 DNA 条带长出来。
works.idea_en: Reprogram molecules by changing which pieces are in the mix, like software on hardware.
works.idea_zh: 改变混合物里有哪些零件，就能重新编程分子，好比在硬件上换软件。
works.method: Single-stranded tiles bind by sticky-end matching to implement Boolean cellular automata row by row on a DNA origami seed; AFM images reveal the computation.
works.method_zh: 单链瓦片按黏性末端匹配结合，以 DNA 折纸为种子逐行实现布尔元胞自动机，原子力显微镜图像显示计算结果。

works.title: Nonlinear decision-making with enzymatic neural networks
works.description: DNA and enzyme reactions formed neural networks that classify inputs into regions of any shape, the kind of non-linear decisions earlier molecular networks could not make.
works.description_zh: DNA 与酶反应构成的神经网络，能把输入分到任意形状的区域中，做到以往分子网络做不到的非线性决策。
works.idea_en: Chemistry that makes non-linear decisions opens the way to smart diagnostics.
works.idea_zh: 能做非线性决策的化学反应，为智能诊断打开了道路。
works.method: Enzyme-driven DNA templates act as neurons with activation and inhibition, and are run in thousands of microdroplets to map their decision boundaries.
works.method_zh: 由酶驱动的 DNA 模板充当带激活和抑制的神经元，在数千个微液滴中运行以绘制决策边界。

works.title: Medium scale integration of molecular logic gates in an automaton (MAYA-II)
works.description: MAYA-II is a DNA computer that plays tic-tac-toe against a human on a 3×3 plate of wells: the player adds a DNA strand for each move and the well where the machine plays lights up.
works.description_zh: MAYA-II 是一台 DNA 计算机，在 3×3 的孔板上与人下井字棋：玩家每走一步就加入一条 DNA 链，机器要下的那一格就会发光。
works.idea_en: Molecular logic you can play against.
works.idea_zh: 一种你可以和它对弈的分子逻辑。
works.method: 128 deoxyribozyme logic gates distributed across nine wells cleave a fluorescent substrate when their input strands are present.
works.method_zh: 128 个脱氧核酶逻辑门分布在九个孔中，当输入链存在时切割荧光底物而发光。

works.title: A primordial DNA store and compute engine
works.description: A soft polymer 'dendricolloid' holds DNA files that can be stored, read, erased, rewritten and used to solve small sudoku and chess problems in one device.
works.description_zh: 一种柔软的聚合物“树枝状胶体”承载 DNA 文件，可以在同一个装置里存储、读取、擦除、重写，并用来解小型数独和国际象棋问题。
works.idea_en: Keep storage and computation together in DNA, as in a computer.
works.idea_zh: 像电脑一样，在 DNA 中把存储和计算放在一起。
works.method: DNA is loaded onto a branched polymer scaffold that protects it; enzymes and strand operations read and modify data in place.
works.method_zh: 把 DNA 装载在起保护作用的分支聚合物支架上，用酶和链操作就地读取和修改数据。
